title: Advogado especialista em imigração
description:
Advogado(a) especialista em Imigração Internacional


A Access International Services é uma consultoria internacional em expansão, especializada em mobilidade global, estruturação patrimonial e soluções jurídicas estratégicas para clientes que buscam viver, investir ou expandir suas operações fora do Brasil.


Local de trabalho: Híbrido – Vila Olímpia, São Paulo – SP

Tipo de contrato: (PJ)

Remuneração: (a combinar)

Sobre a posição:

Como Advogado de Imigração - Legal Writer, você será responsável por:

  • Preparar documentos jurídicos e petições de imigração com excelência técnica e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Analisar a estratégia do caso e a documentação;
  • Pesquisar para reunir os detalhes necessários para documentos e materiais complementares;
  • Elaborar documentos de suporte (como cartas e resumos jurídicos) em inglês;
  • Garantir a conformidade com as regulamentações locais e internacionais de imigração;
  • Prestar suporte técnico-jurídico à equipe e aos clientes, desenvolvendo estratégias eficazes para cada caso;
  • Pesquisar jurisprudências e atualizar-se sobre mudanças nas políticas de imigração;
  • Redigir relatórios e análises com linguagem clara e objetiva.

Requisitos:

  • Formação em Direito com OAB ativa;
  • Experiência mínima de 3 anos em processos de imigração, com foco em Estados Unidos;
  • Excelência na comunicação escrita, com domínio técnico e sensibilidade para diferentes contextos culturais;
  • Fluência em inglês (escrita e leitura avançadas; outros idiomas são um diferencial);
  • Perfil organizado, detalhista e proativo;
  • Habilidade para lidar com prazos e situações de pressão.

Principais responsabilidades do cargo:

  • Redação de Pareceres e Relatórios;
  • Estudos de legislação estrangeira na esfera administrativa e jurídica;
  • Atuação em direito internacional privado, comércio exterior, imigração, documento e contratos internacionais;
  • Trabalho com as leis de cidadania, imigração, especialmente nas áreas de cidadania europeia, green card, e vistos;
  • Atuação com estruturas de holding e a legislação aplicável a empresas internacionais;
  • Interface com clientes (troca de e-mail, mensagens e telefonema);
  • Interface com parceiros no exterior.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com Green Card (EB-2 NIW, EB-1, etc.);
  • Vivência com clientes high ticket;
  • Experiência com direito internacional privado;
  • Atuação com estruturas internacionais (empresas, holdings, etc.);
  • Admissão em BAR (EUA) será considerado um diferencial altamente relevante.

title: Data Software Engineer (US/UK International Projects)
description:
Software Engineer - Data Platform (International Client)

Location: Florianópolis, Brazil | Hybrid

Language: English (daily use with US/UK clients)


About the Opportunity

Join our consultancy team and work directly with a leading insurance company in the US/UK, building their complete data platform from the ground up. This is your chance to bring world-class, AI augmented software engineering practices to a greenfield data engineering project while collaborating daily with international teams.


What You'll Do

  • Design and build a robust data platform for a major insurance company
  • Orchestrate AI agents to research, plan and implement complex data pipelines while demonstrating to the wider team how to leverage these tools to increase velocity and quality.
  • Bring solid software engineering principles to data engineering challenges
  • Work embedded within the client's team, driving technical excellence
  • Collaborate in English with distributed teams across the US and UK


What We're Looking For

Must Have:

  • Excellent communication skills in English - you'll be working daily with international clients
  • Strong software engineering mindset - clean code, testing, reliability, and maintainability are in your DNA
  • Deep understanding of relational databases and large-scale data systems
  • Full AI-Augmented Development - you're already using AI agents and modern dev tools


You'll Thrive Here If:

  • You want international exposure while staying in Brazil
  • You value engineering excellence over quick fixes
  • You're excited about hybrid work (office + remote flexibility in Floripa)
  • You see data engineering as a software engineering discipline


About Us

We're a Florianópolis-based software development and consultancy company working with clients in the US and UK. We believe in combining the best of Brazilian tech talent with international opportunities.


Ready to level up your career with international experience? Let's talk.

description:
Ser a melhor solução para empresas que queiram atingir a alta performance através das pessoas, só é possível com um time eficiente, que desafia o convencional e usa seus potenciais em inovação e crescimento de negócios.

title: Content Operations Specialist
description:
Must Apply Online. Use Form below.


Company Description


Sofia Health is a U.S.-based wellness technology company and two-sided marketplace connecting people to trusted health and wellness professionals. We support providers with tools for visibility, scheduling, and bookings across therapy, coaching, fitness, nutrition, and integrative health.

We are hiring a Content Operations Manager to own how content and provider visibility are planned, organized, and distributed across email, blog, LinkedIn, social media, and podcast channels .


Role Description


The Content Operations Manager is responsible for managing content operations across all major channels and ensuring providers on the Sofia Health platform are consistently surfaced through structured, repeatable systems.


This role focuses on planning, coordination, prioritization, and execution flow — working with existing content, provider profiles, and internal team members to ensure content moves smoothly from planning to publication.


The role also involves leveraging data and analytics to refine content strategies, driving engagement, and ensuring operational efficiencies in content processes.


What You Will Do


Content & Provider Curation

  • Review and audit provider profiles on the Sofia Health platform
  • Organize providers by modality, topic, availability, and seasonality
  • Maintain a structured rotation system to ensure fair and consistent exposure
  • Select providers and content to feature based on campaigns and priorities

Cross-Channel Content Management

  • Plan and coordinate content across:
  • Email marketing
  • Blog
  • LinkedIn
  • Social media
  • Podcast promotions
  • Build weekly and monthly content plans aligning providers, topics, and channels
  • Ensure content is accurate, current, and aligned across all surfaces

Podcast & Media Coordination

  • Manage podcast promotion workflows, including:
  • Episode launch coordination
  • Provider or guest features
  • Cross-posting to email, blog, and social channels
  • Ensure podcast content is repurposed and distributed consistently

Coordination & Execution Flow

  • Create clear content briefs, lineups, and timelines for:
  • Email upload and formatting support
  • Social scheduling support
  • Podcast and blog publishing
  • Manage handoffs between team members to ensure timely publication
  • Review scheduled content for accuracy, completeness, and coverage

Lead Awareness & Performance Tracking

  • Monitor inbound interest generated from content
  • Flag provider-related leads and opportunities for follow-up
  • Track engagement and performance across channels
  • Identify patterns in what drives clicks, inquiries, and bookings


Who You Are

  • Highly organized and detail-oriented
  • Comfortable managing content across multiple channels at scale
  • Strong written English (professional working proficiency)
  • Process-driven and systems-oriented
  • Able to prioritize independently and manage recurring workflows
  • Clear communicator who keeps work moving across teams


Qualifications

  • Content development and management skills, including the ability to write, edit, and optimize engaging and impactful content
  • Proficiency in content strategy and workflow management, as well as experience with content management systems (CMS)
  • Strong analytical skills with an ability to interpret data and apply insights to enhance content performance
  • Experience in collaborating with cross-functional teams, including marketing, design, and product teams
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with an ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Knowledge of SEO, digital marketing principles, and content optimization best practices
  • Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Marketing, Journalism, or a related field
  • Experience in the health or wellness industry is highly desirable

title: SAP FI/CO (Inglês Avançado)
description:
SAP FI Specialist


Summary: Support and enhance Lubrizol Global SAP Procure to Pay (PTP) and Record to Report (RTR) process as a specialist,

with a primary focus on Procurement, Finance, Cost, Tax, and Localization solutions for Brazil and Mexico. Experience with CO.

Leverage deep knowledge of procurement and financial operations, tax calculation and compliance reporting within the Brazilian and Mexican legislative environments.

Engage with business stakeholders across the globe to ensure alignment and support across strategic priorities, technical domains, and standardized practices globally while ensuring that local and regional requirements are met.

Responsibilities:

Analyze, configure, test,deploy, and support SAP ECC and S/4 HANA solutions focused on PTP and RTR, especially as they relate to Procurement,

Finance, and Tax processes for Brazil and Mexico (including Nota Fiscal, CFDI, SPED, and related regulatory reporting).

Make recommendations for improving business processes and technology enablement, particularly around local tax compliance and statutory reporting.

Ensure accurate localization of SAP solutions to comply with Brazilian and Mexican legal and fiscal requirements, including tax calculation engines, e invoicing, and withholding tax management.

Develop standard business process design, configure, test, deploy and support SAP ECC and S/4 HANA solutions along with any bolt on for all procurement processes.

Effectively communicate and collaborate with Procurement, Finance, Tax, IT Business Partners, and Senior Leadership, as well as with other business stakeholders.

Resolve integration points between RTR, Procure to Pay (PTP), Order to Cash (OTC), and Treasury processes to ensure they are properly addressed.

Support daily operations for SAP Procurement, Finance, and Tax processes, including issue resolution, user support, and change management.

Makes decisions applicable to level of influence in the organization. Collaborate with cross functional teams to align local tax and statutory requirements with global standard processes.

Utilize technical and functional expertise to support Procurement, Finance, and Tax initiatives.

Participate in or lead projects implementing or upgrading, tax localization, and compliance solutions.

title: Product Manager Sênior - Planejamento Comercial
description:
Sobre a posição no jogo

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Product Manager Sênior para liderar a evolução das soluções de Planejamento Comercial , atuando na interseção entre negócio, dados e tecnologia.

Essa posição tem como missão maximizar a rentabilidade e a eficiência do portfólio de produtos, conectando o ciclo de vida do produto (PLM) à inteligência de mercado e ao planejamento de compras , garantindo decisões orientadas por dados, menor time-to-market e melhor alocação de capital em estoque.

Você será responsável por transformar dores do time comercial (Buying & Planning) em produtos digitais escaláveis, garantindo adoção real, automação e impacto direto em KPIs críticos do negócio.


Missão da Área

Maximizar a rentabilidade e a eficiência do portfólio de produtos através da tecnologia, integrando o ciclo de vida do produto (PLM) à inteligência de mercado, para suportar decisões de compra e sortimento orientadas por dados, com maior agilidade e menor risco.


Objetivos estratégicos do produto

  • Digitalização do ciclo de vida do Produto;
  • Implementar e evoluir a plataforma de PLM, centralizando o desenvolvimento desde o conceito até a ficha técnica final;
  • Inteligência de Compra e Planejamento;
  • Criar ou integrar soluções que automatizem o cálculo de OTB (Open to Buy) e recomendem sortimento ideal por canal, região e perfil de demanda.
  • Conexão com o Mercado;
  • Traduzir tendências, dados de concorrência e sinais de mercado em parâmetros técnicos para o desenvolvimento e planejamento de novos produtos;
  • Eficiência Operacional;
  • Reduzir rupturas, excessos de estoque e markdowns por meio de previsões de demanda, planejamento integrado e automação de processos.


Responsabilidades

  • Definir e liderar a visão e estratégia do produto de Planejamento Comercial , alinhando tecnologia às necessidades do negócio;
  • Gerenciar a evolução contínua das ferramentas de PLM e Planning , garantindo estabilidade, escalabilidade e adoção;
  • Atuar como braço tecnológico do time comercial , conduzindo discovery com compradores, planejadores e áreas correlatas;
  • Traduzir dores de negócio em soluções digitais, processos otimizados e integrações sistêmicas ;
  • Garantir a arquitetura e integridade dos dados de produto , do nascimento no PLM até a venda no PDV e e-commerce;
  • Avaliar e conduzir decisões de Build vs. Buy , considerando custo, tempo, escalabilidade e aderência ao negócio;
  • Priorizar roadmap e backlog com base em impacto em rentabilidade, eficiência operacional e risco de estoque ;
  • Trabalhar em parceria com Engenharia, Dados, SAP e fornecedores externos;
  • Garantir que o plano de compras aprovado seja convertido em pedidos automatizados (PO) no SAP , com mínima intervenção manual;
  • Monitorar e comunicar resultados por meio de KPIs claros e orientados a impacto .


Escopo Tecnológico

Você atuará diretamente na evolução e integração dos seguintes pilares:

  • PLM (Product Lifecycle Management)
  • Desenvolvimento de produtos, fornecedores, custos, ciclo de vida e cadastros.
  • Demand Planning & Analytics
  • Modelagem de dados e algoritmos para suporte ao planejamento de compras.
  • Market Intelligence Hub
  • Integração de APIs e dados externos de mercado e concorrência.
  • ERP (SAP – MM / Retail)
  • Integração robusta para automação do ciclo de compra, pedidos e cadastros.
  • Automação do Planejamento para Pedido
  • Conversão de planejamento em Pedidos de Compra (PO) automáticos
  • Sincronização de mestres (materiais e fornecedores)
  • Monitoramento de status de recebimento e notas fiscais


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência sólida como Product Manager Sênior em contextos de varejo, indústria ou operações comerciais complexas ;
  • Conhecimento profundo do ciclo de vida do produto (PLM, Buying, Planning, Supply) ;
  • Experiência atuando com sistemas corporativos e integrações (ex.: ERP, PLM, Planning);
  • Forte capacidade analítica, com uso de dados para tomada de decisão ;
  • Vivência em discovery com áreas não-digitais (ex.: Comercial, Compras, Planejamento);
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis ;
  • Comunicação clara, estruturada e habilidade em negociação de prioridades com múltiplos stakeholders .


Diferenciais Desejáveis

  • Experiência prévia com SAP MM ou SAP Retail ;
  • Conhecimento em OTB (Open to Buy) , planejamento de sortimento e previsão de demanda;
  • Domínio de SQL, Power BI ou ferramentas analíticas similares ;
  • Experiência em decisões de Build vs. Buy e gestão de fornecedores de software;
  • Atuação em ambientes de transformação digital de áreas comerciais .


O que define sucesso nessa posição

  • Redução do lead time do ciclo de desenvolvimento de produtos (briefing → venda);
  • Alta taxa de adoção das ferramentas pelo time de Compras e Planejamento;
  • Crescimento do percentual de pedidos automatizados (Zero-Touch PO) ;
  • Melhor aderência ao OTB planejado ;
  • Redução de markdowns e maior venda a preço cheio.


Por que essa vaga é especial?

Porque você vai liderar um produto que atua no coração da decisão comercial da empresa , conectando estratégia, dados e execução.

Aqui, decisões de produto impactam diretamente margem, capital investido em estoque e velocidade de reação ao mercado . É uma posição para quem gosta de complexidade real , influência transversal e impacto mensurável no resultado do negócio.

Bora movimentar o esporte.

title: Quality Assurance (QA) — Funcional / Manual
description:
Estamos buscando profissionais de QA para atuação em qualidade ponta a ponta, com foco em validação funcional, evidências e rastreabilidade das entregas em um ecossistema com microserviços, integrações e múltiplos meios de pagamento.


Junte-se a um time orientado à inovação, focado em excelência de automação e qualidade, sob a liderança de um Coordenador de Engenharia de QA experiente.


Responsabilidades:

  • Planejar, executar e evidenciar testes funcionais ponta a ponta, garantindo aderência às regras de negócio.
  • Criar e manter cenários/casos de teste e evidências com rastreabilidade em Jira/Xray (preferencialmente com Gherkin quando aplicável).
  • Participar de refinamentos, entendimento de regras e definição de critérios de aceite.
  • Executar testes de regressão, testes exploratórios e suporte a UAT/homologação.
  • Validar integrações e fluxos críticos envolvendo APIs, microserviços, mensageria (SQS), ERP e meios de pagamento (Pix/Boleto/Cartão).
  • Acompanhar incidentes/bugs, priorização e retestes junto aos times de desenvolvimento e produto.
  • Garantir rastreabilidade entre requisito ↔ teste ↔ evidência ↔ defeito (Jira/Xray).


Conhecimentos obrigatórios:

  • Experiência com testes funcionais e processos de qualidade em ambientes ágeis.
  • Vivência com sistemas distribuídos e integrações (APIs/microserviços).
  • Capacidade de validar APIs com ferramentas como Postman/Insomnia (validação de payload, status code e regra).
  • Vivência com Jira e ferramenta de gestão de testes (ex.: Xray).
  • Boa escrita de cenários, critérios de aceite e documentação de evidências.
  • Experiência com regressão e priorização de cenários críticos.


Habilidades Desejáveis:

  • Noções de observabilidade (Dynatrace/Loki) para apoio à triagem e evidências.
  • Experiência com jornadas de Checkout e Pagamentos (Pix, boleto, cartão) e fluxos correlatos.
  • Noções de segurança/controles (ex.: PCI) do ponto de vista de testes (cuidados com dados sensíveis e evidências).
  • Conhecimento básico de ambientes cloud/AWS e dinâmica de múltiplos ambientes (multi-account).

title: SAP Basis Engineer
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Nosso Cliente

Você atuará em um projeto global de grande porte no segmento de energia, com ambiente SAP robusto e crítico, composto por aproximadamente 15 sistemas produtivos ECC e S/4HANA

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Administração e configuração de ambientes SAP (Basis)
  • Suporte e sustentação de sistemas SAP (performance, interfaces e disponibilidade)
  • Troubleshooting e resolução de incidentes críticos
  • Monitoramento técnico e tuning de performance
  • Execução de rotinas de manutenção (RFCs, profiles, housekeeping, etc.)
  • Planejamento e execução de upgrades e melhorias
  • Gestão de backup & recovery
  • Atuação com replicação de dados (SLT)
  • Execução de testes de Disaster Recovery e Cyber Recovery
  • Participação em modelo Follow The Sun (FTS) para suporte global
  • Atuação em ambientes ágeis (squads, sprints, backlog - ADO)
  • Participação em escala de plantão (on-call rotativo)

O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência sólida em SAP Basis
  • Vivência com SAP S/4HANA e SAP HANA Database
  • Experiência com SAP NetWeaver (ABAP e Java)
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas como Solution Manager, Focused Run ou SAP LaMa
  • Experiência com troubleshooting, tuning e monitoramento de sistemas SAP
  • Conhecimento em backup & recovery
  • Experiência com replicação de dados (SLT)
  • Conhecimento em sistemas operacionais e suporte a banco de dados
  • Experiência com scripts (PowerShell ou Shell)
  • Vivência com gestão de incidentes, problemas e mudanças
  • Inglês avançado (atuação global)


Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Conhecimento em HANA Pacemaker
  • Experiência com ambientes de alta disponibilidade
  • Vivência em projetos globais e ambientes complexos
  • Perfil proativo e colaborativo
  • Facilidade para atuar em times ágeis

Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

title: Especialista em Customer Success / Account Manager
description:
Nós, da Knewin , somos líderes na América Latina quando se trata de ajudar empresas e marcas a gerenciar sua reputação e presença online através de análises de dados. Com mais de 2000 clientes , nosso objetivo é conectar nossos parceiros com seu público-alvo, visando conquistar sua preferência e alcançar resultados excepcionais para seus negócios. Valorizamos uma cultura que prioriza a agilidade, a flexibilidade e a satisfação do cliente, enquanto acreditamos no potencial transformador da tecnologia, do conhecimento e, principalmente, das pessoas.


Buscamos uma pessoa Especialista em Customer Success / Account Manager para atuar como guardiã da experiência de nossos clientes, garantindo impacto real nos resultados e expansão sustentável da carteira. Você será responsável por conduzir relacionamentos estratégicos, conectar problemas de negócio às soluções da Knewin e atuar como principal voz do cliente internamente.


É uma posição que combina visão analítica, capacidade consultiva e uma execução disciplinada — sustentada por relações de confiança, foco em metas e busca contínua por excelência.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Gerir uma carteira de clientes estratégicos, garantindo retenção, expansão e geração de valor contínuo;
  • Relacionar-se com grandes empresas e stakeholders seniores
  • Entender necessidades de negócio e traduzir em soluções práticas, construindo e conduzindo planos de sucesso (Success Plans) com metas claras, indicadores e rituais de acompanhamento;
  • Atuar proativamente para prevenir churn com base em dados, comportamento de uso e sinais de risco.


Relacionamento Consultivo

  • Conduzir reuniões presenciais e apresentações executivas
  • Atuar como ponto focal entre cliente e times internos, sendo a principal referência do cliente dentro da Knewin, traduzindo necessidades em soluções;
  • Facilitar a adoção de produtos e orientar sobre melhores práticas;
  • Conduzir rituais executivos (QBRs/EBRs), apresentando resultados e roadmap de evolução.


Operação & Execução

  • Acompanhar métricas-chave como NRR, GRR, churn, engajamento e Earned Growth (NPS+);
  • Registrar interações, status e oportunidades no CRM com precisão e disciplina;
  • Trabalhar em parceria com Produtos, Suporte, Dados e Comercial para resolução de problemas, ativação de melhorias e identificação de oportunidades.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Vivência prévia em Customer Success, Account Management, Consultoria, Projetos ou áreas correlatas;
  • Capacidade de realizar gestão de carteira com organização, priorização e disciplina;
  • Habilidade de comunicação clara, objetiva e orientada a solução;
  • Conhecimento de métricas SaaS (MRR, churn, NRR, expansão, adoção);
  • Vivência com ferramentas como CRM (HubSpot/Salesforce), planilhas e plataformas de suporte;
  • Disponibilidade e habilidade para conduzir reuniões presenciais com C-level
  • Residir na cidade de São Paulo ou municípios vizinhos .


Desejáveis

  • Experiência com produtos SaaS B2B;
  • Vivência em análise de dados ou uso de dashboards;
  • Experiência em atendimento a clientes enterprise/governo/corporativo;
  • Conhecimento em NPS, Customer Journey e metodologias de CS (ex.: WbD, Success Playbooks).


Diferenciais

  • Atuação prévia em empresas com foco em reputação, comunicação, PRTech ou martech;
  • Familiaridade com metodologias de consultoria (McKinsey, Bain, BCG);
  • Experiência com processos de expansão e cross-sell;
  • Histórico de alta performance em ambientes com metas arrojadas;
  • Participação na construção de processos, playbooks ou CS Ops;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em ambientes de transformação e crescimento acelerado.


Cultura de Cliente

  • Atuar com comunicação clara, cumprimento de combinados e foco em experiência (clientes parceiros);
  • Contribuir para uma operação ágil, simples e baseada em dados (planos efetivos);
  • Colaborar com times internos para garantir entregas confiáveis e melhorar processos continuamente.

title: SDET - Test Automation Engineer
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Automation Test Engineer (SDET) to join a Wealth Management technology team responsible for applications used by financial advisors to manage client portfolios, investment models, and portfolio rebalancing strategies.

In this role, you will primarily focus on building and expanding automated testing solutions, improving test coverage, and supporting scalable testing practices integrated with CI/CD pipelines. You will also contribute to functional validation when necessary while helping strengthen the team’s overall automation capabilities.

These systems support critical financial workflows and data-driven processes, requiring strong attention to accuracy, data validation, and analytical thinking.


Key Responsibilities

Test Automation & Development

· Design, develop, and maintain automated test cases for UI and API layers

· Extend and enhance the existing automation framework based on Katalon Studio

· Implement automation using Playwright and modern automation frameworks

· Convert existing manual test cases into automated regression tests

· Contribute to expanding and maintaining the automated regression test suite

· Contribute to improving test architecture, automation frameworks, and engineering practices

Quality Assurance & Validation

· Create and maintain test cases, test scripts, and testing documentation

· Perform manual validation when required to support quality assurance

· Validate system functionality across portfolio management and investment workflows

· Conduct data validation and API response verification (JSON)

· Ensure test coverage across critical business scenarios and edge cases

· Analyze system behavior to ensure accuracy in data-driven and calculation-heavy workflows

Continuous Integration & Testing

· Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines

· Enable continuous regression testing as part of the development lifecycle

· Contribute to improving release confidence and deployment quality

Collaboration & Quality Improvement

· Collaborate closely with developers, business analysts, product owners, and QA engineers

· Identify quality risks early and communicate them clearly to the team

· Suggest improvements to testing strategies and automation frameworks

· Contribute ideas to improve automation efficiency and testing scalability


Technical Environment

Automation Tools

· Katalon Studio

· Playwright

· Additional automation frameworks when appropriate

Testing Types

· UI automation

· API testing

· JSON-based data validation

· Regression automation

Technology Stack (context)

· Frontend: Angular

· Backend: Java

· APIs: REST services

DevOps

· CI/CD pipelines

· Automated test execution during development cycles


Required Qualifications

· Strong experience in test automation engineering (QA Automation / SDET)

· Proven hands-on experience building and maintaining automated test suites

· Hands-on experience with automation frameworks and scripting

· Experience with UI automation tools such as Katalon, Playwright, Selenium, or similar frameworks

· Experience performing API testing and validation

· Familiarity with JSON request/response validation

· Experience working with automation integrated into CI/CD environments

· Strong understanding of test design principles and test case development

· Ability to work effectively in Agile development environments

· Strong analytical mindset and attention to detail, especially when validating complex data and calculations

· Ability to test complex workflows and algorithm-driven systems

· Advanced/Fluent English


Nice-to-Have Qualifications

· Basic programming or scripting experience (Java or similar)

· Experience with financial systems or wealth management platforms

· Exposure to portfolio management or trading systems

· Experience working with data-heavy or analytics-driven platforms

· Experience scaling automation frameworks in enterprise environments

title: Business Systems Administrator
description:
Business Systems Administrator


Location : Remote (Brazil)



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted technology partner is scaling its operational systems ecosystem and is seeking a Business Systems Administrator to support the stability, integration, and growth of its core business platforms. As the organisation expands, this role will play a key part in ensuring systems remain reliable, integrated, and optimised while supporting AI-enabled workflows and operational efficiency.



Position Overview


We are seeking an experienced Business Systems Administrator to support the daily operation, optimization, and expansion of core business systems. This contractor role will serve as a central technical and strategic partner to Business Operations, ensuring that the organization’s systems ecosystem remains stable, integrated, scalable, and capable of supporting future growth. This role requires experience managing multiple interconnected platforms, building integrations and APIs, and implementing automation and AI-powered solutions that improve operational efficiency and decision-making. Core systems include platforms such as HubSpot, Gong, Maxio, Arrows, ZoomInfo , and other operational and revenue tools.




What You'll Do:


  • Manage the day-to-day administration and performance of core business systems
  • Maintain system access, permissions, and overall platform reliability
  • Build and maintain integrations and APIs across CRM, revenue, and operational systems
  • Troubleshoot system issues and ensure reliable data flow between platforms
  • Support the implementation of automation and AI-powered workflows
  • Assist with onboarding and rollout of new tools and platforms
  • Ensure data accuracy, governance, and reporting across systems
  • Partner with internal teams to improve processes and system efficiency.



What You Bring:


  • 3+ years of experience managing business systems in a SaaS or high-growth environment
  • Strong experience administering CRM and revenue platforms (HubSpot required)
  • Proven experience building and managing APIs and system integrations
  • Experience working with multi-system ecosystems
  • Hands-on experience implementing automation or AI-enabled tools
  • Strong systems thinking and architectural mindset
  • Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
  • High attention to detail and focus on data integrity
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to translate business needs into technical solutions.



Nice to Have

  • Experience with Gong, Maxio, Arrows, ZoomInfo , or similar revenue operations tools
  • Familiarity with iPaaS tools such as Zapier, Make, or Workato
  • Experience supporting Customer Success and Revenue Operations teams
  • Background in process optimization and change management
  • Experience working in private equity-backed or rapidly scaling organizations.



What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation
  • Fully remote work environment
  • Opportunity to work with modern SaaS platforms and automation tools
  • High-impact role supporting business operations and systems strategy
  • Collaborative and fast-growing environment with strong ownership.

title: Analista de Implantação - SAAS (Jr)
description:
Somos protagonistas na transformação digital dos meios de pagamento, somos a HST!

Desvendamos os desafios mais complexos e desde a nossa fundação temos a missão de tornar as transações eletrônicas mais seguras.

Estamos presentes em +20 Países e, dentre os nossos Clientes, estão os 8 Bancos mais importantes do Brasil e os 20 da América Latina!

São +80.000 terminais de autoatendimento; +1.000.000 autenticações de transações de compras eletrônicas ao mês; +800.000 cartões bancários com chip disponibilizados ao mês em lojas e agências bancárias; e até em 2024, foram +100 bancos utilizando nossos sistemas de emissor que permitem a tokenização de cartões COF (Card on File) e eCommerce. Isso é só uma parte dos nossos resultados, mas também é só começo!

Nos bastidores de todas as nossas conquistas está o nosso Time, que conta com +200 Pessoas envolvidas no desenvolvimento das nossas soluções. Pessoas questionadoras, curiosas, criativas, proativas, colaborativas e abertas a novas experiências!


Para saber mais sobre a HST e sobre as nossas oportunidades, acesse:


Buscamos uma pessoa Analista de Implantação - SAAS (Jr) para se unir ao nosso Time de Operations para:

  • Apoiar na criação e atualização de materiais de treinamento e documentação técnica;
  • Atendimento a projetos de clientes nacionais e internacionais;
  • Monitoração de ambientes através do Zabbiz e Grafana;
  • Participar de chamadas com clientes nacionais e internacionais para implantação de projetos, inicialmente com acompanhamento e evoluindo para condução conforme ganho de experiência;
  • Participar de reuniões de treinamento e/ou alinhamento da solução com clientes, fabricantes e parceiros;
  • Abertura de demandas técnicas para os times internos;
  • Apoiar na instalação da solução e nas atualizações dos ambientes de homologação e produção, seguindo procedimentos definidos e com acompanhamento do time mais experiente;
  • Registrar, atualizar e acompanhar implementação de projetos, garantindo histórico claro, comunicação adequada e cumprimento dos SLAs.
  • Manter comunicação clara e contínua com os clientes durante o ciclo de vida do projeto, informando status, próximos passos e orientações.


Acreditamos ser importante que você já tenha passado por algumas experiências e que também tenha os seguintes conhecimentos:

  • Formação superior completa na área de tecnologia;
  • Experiência na área suporte/operações em atendimento ao cliente externo - nacional ou internacional;
  • Experiencia atuando em ambiente de trabalho na área de softwares com atividades de configuração, manutenção e treinamento de clientes;
  • Conhecimento e/ou vivência em troubleshooting e análise de logs;
  • Conhecimentos básicos em redes e protocolos de segurança;
  • Conhecimentos nos sistemas operacionais Windows e Linux
  • Disponibilidade de atuar esporádicas vezes (uma vez a cada 30 ou 45 dias) presencialmente na sede da empresa, em Campinas/SP.


Será um grande diferencial se:

  • Conhecimento básico ou contato prévio com Docker, Ansible, Apache e Kong;
  • Conhecimentos básicos de Scrum;
  • Conhecimento ou vivência em monitoração de serviços;
  • Vivência em atividades rotineiras de suporte e projetos, como acompanhamento, execução e atualização de tickets;
  • Noções de comunicação com o cliente e acompanhamento de indicadores (ex.: SLA, FCR, tempo de resposta, entre outros);
  • Espanhol e/ou Inglês em nível básico a intermediário;
  • Conhecimento com produtos, ou com os conceitos relacionados com meios de pagamento.


O que oferecemos?

A HST é uma empresa certificada GPTW! Oferecemos a oportunidade de crescimento em um ambiente de desafios em que a contrapartida de cada Pessoa equivale ao tamanho da sua vontade de crescer !

  • Contratação em regime CLT;
  • Atuação 100% Remota;
  • Horário flexível;

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer with strong expertise in Oracle and ODI (Oracle Data Integrator) to join our team and support enterprise-grade data initiatives.

This role is ideal for professionals who thrive in complex data environments , working with large-scale Data Warehouses and mission-critical systems — especially within financial services or similar industries.

You will be responsible for designing, developing, and optimizing ETL/ELT pipelines , ensuring high standards of data quality, performance, and reliability .

  • Build and maintain scalable Data Warehouse solutions
  • Develop complex SQL and PL/SQL logic (procedures, packages, functions)
  • Implement data quality, reconciliation, and auditing frameworks

  • Develop and manage ODI Load Plans and workflows
  • Troubleshoot and debug data pipelines and mappings
  • Translate business requirements into technical specifications
  • Integrate multiple data sources (databases, files, APIs)

title: Business Development Manager (BDM) - FOREX BROKERAGE
description:
Disruptive Talents, a boutique headhunting and strategic recruitment firm, is collaborating with an international Forex brokerage to identify a Business Development Manager (BDM) – Brazil.


At Disruptive Talents, we connect commercially driven talent with high-growth financial services organizations. This search is conducted on behalf of an international Forex brokerage seeking to accelerate client acquisition, strategic partnerships, and revenue growth across the Brazilian and Latin American markets.


This is a strategic opportunity to join the commercial growth team at a critical stage of the company’s expansion in Brazil, playing a central role in developing client relationships, strategic partnerships, and long-term revenue growth in the local market.


About the Company


A regulated international Forex brokerage operating across multiple jurisdictions, the company provides trading access and infrastructure solutions to professional traders, institutional clients, introducing brokers (IBs), asset managers, and strategic partners. With a growing global footprint and a strong emphasis on technology, compliance, and scalable brokerage solutions, the firm continues to expand its presence in key regional markets, including Colombia, Mexico and Brazil.


As a Business Development Manager, you will focus on expanding the company’s footprint among professional traders, institutional clients, introducing brokers (IBs), asset managers, and strategic partners.

The ideal candidate brings a strong understanding of financial markets, brokerage products, and client trading needs, paired with a consultative, relationship-led sales approach.


What You Will Do:


Business Growth & Revenue

  • Identify, develop, and close new business opportunities across FX, CFDs, equities, derivatives, or multi-asset trading solutions.
  • Drive revenue growth through direct client acquisition and strategic partnerships (IBs, affiliates, money managers).
  • Own the full sales cycle: prospecting, pitching, negotiation, onboarding coordination, and account growth.
  • Achieve and exceed individual and team revenue targets.


Client & Partner Management

  • Build long-term relationships with professional traders, institutional clients, and high-value partners.
  • Act as a trusted commercial advisor, aligning client trading needs with platform capabilities, pricing, and liquidity solutions.
  • Support retention and account expansion by identifying cross-sell and upsell opportunities.


Market & Industry Intelligence

  • Stay current on global financial market trends, trading technologies, and competitor offerings.
  • Monitor regulatory developments (e.g., MiFID II, FCA, CySEC, ASIC) and ensure commercial activity aligns with compliance requirements.
  • Represent the company at industry events, conferences, and client meetings.


Internal Collaboration

  • Work closely with trading, liquidity, risk, compliance, and operations teams to ensure seamless client onboarding and service delivery.
  • Partner with marketing to support lead-generation campaigns and regional growth initiatives.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline management, forecasts, and performance reporting via CRM tools.


What We Are Looking For:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or a related field.
  • 3–7+ years of business development, sales, or relationship management experience within financial markets brokerage (FX, CFDs, equities, crypto, or derivatives).
  • Strong understanding of trading platforms, brokerage revenue models, and client acquisition channels.
  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets.
  • Deep interest in financial markets and trading products.
  • Strong negotiation and closing skills.
  • Relationship-driven, consultative sales mindset.
  • Excellent communication and presentation abilities.
  • Highly organized, data-driven, and comfortable working with CRM and reporting tools.


What We Offer:

  • Competitive base salary plus performance-based commission.
  • Exposure to global financial markets and high-value clients.
  • Clear career progression in a fast-growing brokerage environment.
  • Collaborative, performance-oriented culture.


How to Apply:

  • If you thrive in fast-moving financial markets and enjoy building profitable, long-term client relationships, we’d love to hear from you

title: Contract Clinical Research Associate
description:
Location: Brazil (remote)

Type: 12-month contract - attractive hourly compensation.


About Clinergy

Clinergy Health is a boutique CRO focused on delivering high-quality, highly tailored clinical development solutions for pharmaceutical and biotech companies.


We intentionally work with a small number of strategic projects, spanning Phase I to Real-World Evidence, to ensure scientific rigor, operational excellence, and true partnership with our clients.


Role Description

We are looking for a Contract Clinical Research Associate. The Clinical Research Associate will oversee and monitor assigned clinical trials, ensuring compliance with protocols and regulatory requirements. Key responsibilities may include site assessment selection, initiation, and management, coordinating clinical operations, assisting with protocol implementation, and ensuring accurate study documentation. The role involves frequent collaboration with cross-functional teams and adherence to quality standards to meet project timelines.


Activities

  • Support and conduct preparation activities for Site Initiation Visits;
  • Conduct independent monitoring to verify accuracy of study data vs. source records;
  • Ensure requirements for patient privacy are met;
  • Generate and collect study documentation such as consent forms, Essential Documents, Case Report Forms and Investigator Agreements;
  • Conduct and tracks progress of site activities to initiation, enrolment and screening, interim monitoring and close out requirements;
  • Ensure no study tasks are conducted prior to IRB/EC approval and formal site activation;
  • Review Serious Adverse Event (SAE) narratives with sites and medical monitor; Ensure adverse event reporting is done in accordance with regulatory requirements;
  • Organize, conduct and report on Site Qualification, Site Initiation, Interim Monitoring, and Close-out visits;
  • Verify the accuracy of study results;
  • Identify and resolve site issues;


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in life sciences;
  • 2+ years experience as a CRA on pharma or CRO companies(Mandatory);
  • Advanced/Fluent in English;
  • Strong medical and clinical knowledge of indications, therapies, and patient population
  • Proven track record of having good sponsor, investigator, site, and vendor relations
  • Strong computer skills including EDC system experience
  • Demonstrated detailed knowledge of guidelines, systems for clinical trial management and of ICH GCP and international regulations and practices


Skills

  • Self driven individual
  • Sense of urgency
  • Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills
  • Attention to detail and strong organizational skills
  • Good problem solving skills
  • Enthusiastic and energetic


To apply for this opportunity please send your updated CV to


Note: Candidates who do not possess the mandatory requirements specified above will not be considered.

  • Ensure no study tasks are conducted prior to IRB/EC approval and formal site activation;
  • Review Serious Adverse Event (SAE) narratives with sites and medical monitor; Ensure adverse event reporting is done in accordance with regulatory requirements;
  • Organize, conduct and report on Site Qualification, Site Initiation, Interim Monitoring, and Close-out visits;
  • Verify the accuracy of study results;

  • Bachelor’s degree in life sciences;
  • 2+ years experience as a CRA on pharma or CRO companies(Mandatory);
  • Advanced/Fluent in English;
  • Strong medical and clinical knowledge of indications, therapies, and patient population
  • Proven track record of having good sponsor, investigator, site, and vendor relations
  • Strong computer skills including EDC system experience
  • Demonstrated detailed knowledge of guidelines, systems for clinical trial management and of ICH GCP and international regulations and practices


Skills

  • Sense of urgency
  • Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills

  • Enthusiastic and energetic

title: Vibecoder
description:
A Human é um ecossistema criado por criativos para criativos, que nasceu para explorar o encontro entre criatividade humana e inteligência artificial.


Nascemos da prática e estamos criando projetos reais, testando novas ferramentas e desenvolvendo novos fluxos de trabalho todos os dias dentro de empresas como Google, Nestlé e Stone.


Acreditamos que a inteligência artificial não substitui a criatividade, mas expande as possibilidades de quem cria.

Por isso, construímos um ambiente onde pessoas curiosas, inquietas e mão na massa podem explorar, testar, errar, aprender rápido e evoluir junto com o mercado (e junto com a gente).


Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Criar ferramentas, automações e integrações com IA que melhorem o dia a dia dos nossos times;
  • Desenvolver workflows inteligentes para projetos criativos e campanhas;
  • Trabalhar lado a lado com times criativos, estratégicos e de produto;
  • Testar e implementar novas ferramentas (Lovable, Replit, Claude Code, GPT Codex, etc.);
  • Transformar IA em processo (não só em experimentação).


Do que você precisa:

  • Experiência construindo produtos (projetos próprios, freelas, startups ou dentro de empresas);
  • Familiaridade com vibe coding e ferramentas de AI-assisted coding;
  • Mentalidade prática: tirar ideias do papel rápido;
  • Boa comunicação para colaborar com times criativos;
  • Interesse real por criatividade, cultura e tecnologia.


Vai ser um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência criando automações ou agentes de IA;
  • Vivência com ferramentas como Cursor, v0, Bolt, Replit, entre outras;
  • Já ter atuado em projetos criativos ou campanhas;
  • Interesse em explorar novas formas de criação com IA.

title: Senior Delphi Developer
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Developer with 5+ years of Delphi software development experience to join the software engineering team for our U.S. client. This key individual should have experience making decisions, working on a small development team, and working both independently and as part of a small, dynamic team where everything you do makes a difference.


The industry-leading client provides business-automating, enterprise resource planning (ERP) accounting software for the oil & gas industry. The client's software and services streamline and automate complex processes, such as revenue distribution, billing, order management, production accounting, accounts payable, contract management, and more, for over 1,700 customers across 9 countries.


Responsibilities

  • Write well-designed, testable, documented code from the provided project requirements
  • Coordinate requirements, schedules, and activities; contribute to team meetings; and troubleshoot development and production problems across multiple environments and operating platforms
  • Support and develop other developers, providing advice, coaching, and educational opportunities
  • Implement software changes with the awareness and sensitivity of impact on the system as a whole
  • Learn and adhere to the adopted coding standards used by the software ERP Development Team
  • Leverage Delphi experience and learn all other client development tools
  • Monitor assigned software development change requests and implement changes for requests based on priority
  • Review requirements for system changes and enhancements, analyze those requests, and translate them into necessary programming changes
  • Perform necessary designing, coding, debugging, testing, and documentation (using the Delphi IDE and any other necessary tools)


Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written communication skills
  • 5+ years of Delphi and SQL Server experience (FireDAC experience is a plus)
  • Experience with at least one object-oriented programming language (in addition to Delphi/Object Pascal) is a plus, e.g., Java, C#, C++, etc.
  • Experience with defining service architectures and solutions from business requirements, producing estimates, and managing delivery against those timelines
  • Supports and develops other developers by providing advice, cross-training, coaching, and educational opportunities
  • Excellent communication skills, including the ability to engage in technical discussions with peers and become a trusted technical advisor. Work with others to ensure code standards and best practices are followed
  • Experience writing reusable, testable, and efficient code
  • Design and implementation of low-latency, high-availability, and performant applications and services
  • Ability to coordinate requirements, schedules, and activities; contributing to team meetings; troubleshooting development and production problems across multiple environments and operating platforms
  • Implementing unit tests (DUnitX experience is a plus)


Preferred Experience

  • Familiarity with the oil & gas industry and any related applications
  • Experience leading a small to medium-sized team, with assistance from outside parties
  • Understanding the nature of asynchronous programming and its quirks and workarounds
  • User authentication and authorization between multiple systems, servers, and environments
  • Experience with offline storage, threading, and performance tuning
  • Knack for benchmarking and optimization
  • Integration of multiple data sources and databases into one system
  • Understanding the fundamental design principles behind a scalable application
  • Strong proficiency working in a containerized deployment environment
  • Experience writing well-formed RESTful APIs
  • Proficient understanding of code versioning and management tools such as GitHub
  • Working with AI tools within the development workflow


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: AI Python Developer
description:
Role Overview

Client is seeking highly skilled Python Software Engineers to support complex data workloads and AI‑driven systems . This role is ideal for engineers who are deeply hands‑on with Python and PySpark , comfortable working in production environments , and experienced contributing to or actively engaging with open‑source communities .

This position will focus on building production‑grade APIs, scalable data pipelines, and developer tooling , while collaborating across engineering, product, and data teams.

Top Requirement: Candidates must be very strong in Python and PySpark . This is non‑negotiable and should be the primary focus during technical screening.

  • Design and develop production‑grade Python services and APIs supporting AI and data platforms
  • Build and optimize PySpark workloads to support large‑scale data processing
  • Contribute to AI systems and complex data pipelines in production environments
  • Develop developer tooling to streamline the software delivery lifecycle
  • Implement observability, monitoring, and performance optimization strategies
  • Practice infrastructure‑as‑code and deployment automation
  • Collaborate with engineering, product, and data teams on architecture and system design
  • Participate in and contribute to technical discussions and design reviews


Required Skills & Experience

  • Strong Python expertise (primary language)
  • Strong PySpark experience working with large datasets
  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience , primarily in Python
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering , or related field
  • Experience contributing to open‑source projects
  • Code contributions, PRs, or
  • Meaningful participation via issues, discussions, or proposals in major libraries (data science, ML, or LLM ecosystems)
  • Strong experience with Git and platforms such as GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket
  • Experience developing APIs using FastAPI
  • Experience with ML / data libraries such as Scikit‑Learn, TensorFlow , or similar
  • Experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
  • Experience with containers, orchestration systems, and serverless technologies
  • Strong communication skills and ability to articulate technical decisions clearly


Nice to Have

  • Experience with LangChain and/or LangFlow
  • Background supporting LLM‑based or AI‑driven applications
  • Experience building data‑intensive platforms in production
  • Exposure to distributed systems and large‑scale data architectures

  • Supports and develops other developers by providing advice, cross-training, coaching, and educational opportunities
  • Excellent communication skills, including the ability to engage in technical discussions with peers and become a trusted technical advisor. Work with others to ensure code standards and best practices are followed
  • Experience writing reusable, testable, and efficient code
  • Design and implementation of low-latency, high-availability, and performant applications and services
  • Ability to coordinate requirements, schedules, and activities; contributing to team meetings; troubleshooting development and production problems across multiple environments and operating platforms

  • Experience leading a small to medium-sized team, with assistance from outside parties
  • Understanding the nature of asynchronous programming and its quirks and workarounds
  • User authentication and authorization between multiple systems, servers, and environments
  • Experience with offline storage, threading, and performance tuning
  • Knack for benchmarking and optimization
  • Integration of multiple data sources and databases into one system
  • Understanding the fundamental design principles behind a scalable application
  • Strong proficiency working in a containerized deployment environment
  • Experience writing well-formed RESTful APIs
  • Proficient understanding of code versioning and management tools such as GitHub
  • Working with AI tools within the development workflow


Additional Information

  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
SRE for NOC - 1st/2nd Line Support

**Supporting USA Time Zone - 7am to 5pm Pacific time**


Skills

  • SRE
  • Network Operations Centre experience
  • Incident Management - Troubleshoot and Raise Tickets
  • Linux Environment (Commands)
  • Python Scripting
  • Cloud - GCP/AWS


Overview

We are seeking an experienced NOC Support Analyst to join our 24/7 monitoring team. In this role, you will be responsible for proactive system monitoring , first‑line troubleshooting , and escalation to second‑ and third‑line teams when required. Each shift is staffed by two engineers, with one acting as the Manager on Duty (MOD) .


This position is ideal for someone with solid NOC experience who is also looking for career growth opportunities in Automation , SRE , and systems optimisation .


Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor infrastructure, applications, and services to ensure availability and performance.
  • Perform initial triage and first‑line troubleshooting of incidents.
  • Escalate issues appropriately after initial diagnosis.
  • Act as Manager on Duty when assigned, coordinating incident response.
  • Contribute to automation improvements , tooling enhancements , and SRE initiatives .
  • Support staging and pre‑production activities aimed at improving production stability.
  • Collaborate with engineering and operations teams to refine processes and reduce manual intervention.


Required Experience

  • Prior experience working in a Network Operations Center (NOC) or similar operations environment.
  • Strong understanding of monitoring tools, incident workflows, and operational best practices.
  • Comfortable working in a fast‑paced, 24/7 environment with shared responsibility across shifts.


Ideal Candidate Profile

This role may be a great fit for:

  • A Junior Software Engineer with an interest in operational systems, automation, and reliability engineering.
  • Someone eager to grow into an SRE -focused position through hands-on exposure and mentorship.
  • A candidate passionate about operational excellence and continuously improving system reliability.

description:
Há 10 anos no mercado, a V8.Tech é uma empresa jovem, movida por tecnologia e inovação, que acelera a transformação digital. Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • O profissional atuará na migração de códigos Java para .NET.
  • Desenvolver e manter microsserviços e APIs baseadas em arquitetura hexagonal, garantindo a exposição de dados para diferentes clientes por meio de REST APIs e tópicos corporativos.
  • Atuar na evolução e modernização de aplicações legadas escritas em VB6, VB.NET e ASP.NET, integrando-as com novas soluções baseadas em .NET e microserviços.
  • Construir adapters, barramentos e camadas anticorruption (ACL) para interligar sistemas legados a novos serviços de forma segura e desacoplada.
  • Assegurar boas práticas de arquitetura e engenharia de software, aplicando padrões como Arquitetura Hexagonal, DDD e Clean Architecture.
  • Implementar comunicação assíncrona e orientada a eventos, utilizando RabbitMQ para garantir resiliência e desacoplamento entre serviços e sistemas de dados.
  • Criar e otimizar queries SQL e NoSQL, garantindo eficiência e performance em ambientes com alto volume de dados, otimizando o processamento de workloads transacionais e analíticos.
  • Atuar na automação de testes e nos pipelines de CI/CD, promovendo qualidade, rastreabilidade e entregas contínuas.
  • Monitorar performance e identificar gargalos, assegurando respostas rápidas e escalabilidade do sistema.
  • Apoiar a squad na resolução de problemas técnicos complexos, garantindo alinhamento com a arquitetura do projeto.
  • Trabalhar com pipelines de dados e integração com o Data Lake, possibilitando ingestão eficiente para uso por times de Data Science, BI e aplicações analíticas.
  • Colaborar com equipes de DevSecOps para promover segurança e governança do ambiente, assegurando conformidade, rastreabilidade e proteção de dados sensíveis.
  • Implementar estratégias de caching e otimização de latência, garantindo respostas rápidas para consumidores finais e sistemas analíticos.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Sólida experiência com desenvolvimento backend utilizando .NET Core e .NET Framework (C#).
  • Conhecimento prático em VB.NET ou VB6. (Diferencial).
  • Experiência com arquitetura de microsserviços.
  • Vivência com arquitetura hexagonal e padrões de mensageria.
  • Experiência com APIs REST e múltiplos modelos de entrega de dados, como mensageria e data marts.
  • Vivência com CI/CD e automação de infraestrutura utilizando Azure DevOps.
  • Familiaridade com práticas de observabilidade, tracing e logging distribuído.
  • Conhecimento sólido em modelagem e otimização de bancos de dados relacionais (Oracle e PL/SQL).
  • Sybase (Diferencial)
  • Capacidade de atuar em sistemas com alto volume de dados e transações.
  • Experiência prévia em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e colaboração em squads multidisciplinares.


Requisitos desejáveis


  • Experiência com design de APIs escaláveis para diferentes consumidores.
  • Conhecimento avançado em DataOps e integração de pipelines de dados.
  • Familiaridade com Kubernetes e infraestrutura distribuída.
  • Experiência com event sourcing e padrões de mensageria avançados.
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de data lakes e otimização de consumo para analytics
  • Conhecimentos de Java e orientação a objetos.


Benefícios


  • Remuneração CLT compatível com o mercado;
  • Trabalho Remoto.
  • Horário de trabalho flexível: De acordo com área de atuação e política interna;
  • Flash - Cartão de Benefícios Flexíveis com todas as categorias habilitadas: Alimentação, Refeição, Mobilidade, Educação Saúde e Cultura.

title: Amazon Graphic Designer / Creative Strategist
description:
We are hiring an Amazon Graphic Designer to own the strategic development and execution of premium marketplace creatives.


This is not a task-based production role. We are looking for someone who can think strategically, identify what needs to improve visually without being told, build creative briefs from product and customer analysis, and bring ideas from concept through implementation .


The right person understands that great Amazon creative is not just about making listings look better. It is about increasing click-through rate, improving conversion rate, answering buyer decision questions visually, and creating a premium brand experience that feels custom, polished, and mobile-first.



What You’ll Own


You will lead design for:

  • CTR-optimized main images
  • Amazon infographics
  • A+ Content
  • Amazon Brand Stores
  • Amazon ad creatives



What You’ll Be Responsible For


  • Develop high-converting Amazon creative that is visually premium, detail-oriented, mobile-optimized, and aligned to each brand’s positioning
  • Translate product analysis, competitor analysis, review mining, and buyer research into strong visual concepts
  • Build creative briefs independently based on our internal product analysis process
  • Create designs that clearly answer buyer decision questions using strong hierarchy, thoughtful white space, and strategic visual storytelling
  • Use design flow intentionally in A+ Content and Brand Stores to guide the shopper’s eye and improve engagement
  • Identify visual weaknesses and missed opportunities in product listings without needing step-by-step direction
  • Recommend what should be improved across images, modules, storefronts, and ad creatives based on conversion principles
  • Bring ideas from ideation to execution, including concepting, layout, design, revision, and final production-ready files
  • Leverage AI tools to augment product photography, generate lifestyle imagery, and accelerate creative workflows while maintaining a premium, realistic output
  • Ensure all work is marketplace-compliant, polished, and built for conversion
  • Self-audit all work for alignment, consistency, accuracy, realism, proportion, mobile readability, and premium brand presentation
  • Partner with strategy and account teams to prioritize the highest-impact visual opportunities
  • Support A/B testing initiatives and use testing data to inform creative recommendations



What We’re Looking For


  • 5+ years of graphic design experience
  • Strong portfolio of ecommerce design work
  • Strong understanding of Amazon , including the role of main images, image sequencing, A+ flow, and Store navigation
  • Ability to work independently and proactively
  • Strong eye for layout, hierarchy, whitespace, typography, composition, and premium visual presentation
  • Deep attention to detail & your superpower is communication
  • Experience collaborating in a fast-paced environment



Required Skills


  • Expert-level proficiency in Adobe Photoshop
  • Strong working knowledge of design and organizational tools like Figma, Asana, Trello
  • Experience with AI design tools, including Nano Banana, Scalable or comparable
  • Familiarity with A/B testing workflows for creative



What Great Looks Like in This Role


  • You can look at a listing and quickly identify what is hurting CTR or conversion
  • You know how to visually communicate product value without overloading the image
  • You understand how to make creative feel premium, not generic
  • You use AI as an enhancement tool, not a shortcut for low-quality work
  • You care about the details that separate average creative from exceptional creative



Why Work With Us


  • High-impact creative: Your work directly influences CTR, CVR, and revenue


  • Growth-focused brands: Not low-quality, mass-production design work

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Python + React) — AI StartupSenior Full-Stack Engineer - AI Productivity Platform (Remote)
description:
Position: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (AI Platform)


About Us

We are a fast-growing AI startup transforming how professionals interact with complex information. We build enterprise-grade AI productivity platforms used by researchers, analysts, and engineers at large companies and rapidly scaling teams.

Our platform powers advanced AI workflows such as Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), multi-agent systems, document intelligence, and structured data search — with a strong focus on reliability, security, and scalability in production environments.


Job Description

We are looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to help design, build, and scale both the backend systems and frontend experiences of our AI platform. You will work across the entire stack — from Python-based AI orchestration services and data pipelines to the React-based interfaces that bring those capabilities to enterprise users every day.

This role is ideal for engineers who think end-to-end: you care about clean API design and reliable backend architecture, but you're equally motivated by building polished, responsive interfaces that make complex AI workflows feel intuitive.


Responsibilities


Backend & Platform

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable backend services in Python
  • Develop and evolve RESTful and WebSocket APIs supporting AI workflows and enterprise use cases
  • Build and maintain AI orchestration layers (RAG pipelines, agent systems, retrieval modules)
  • Integrate multiple data sources: vector databases, structured/tabular data, files, and web search
  • Own backend architecture decisions with a strong focus on performance, security, and reliability


Frontend & User Experience

  • Build and iterate on production React interfaces using Next.js and TypeScript
  • Translate complex AI capabilities into clean, usable UI patterns — from research dashboards to interactive data views
  • Implement real-time features such as streaming responses, live status indicators, and dynamic content updates
  • Ensure frontend performance, accessibility, and responsiveness across devices


Cross-Cutting

  • Collaborate closely with AI/ML, Design, and Product teams to ship features end-to-end
  • Implement observability, monitoring, logging, and automated testing across the stack
  • Debug and trace issues from the UI through the API layer to backend services
  • Participate in code reviews and help raise the overall engineering bar


Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional engineering experience shipping production software
  • Strong proficiency in Python with experience building backend services (FastAPI or similar)
  • Strong proficiency in React with experience in Next.js and TypeScript
  • Solid understanding of API design, state management, and component architecture
  • Hands-on experience with AWS (e.g. Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB)
  • Experience with relational and non-relational databases
  • Comfort working across the full stack — you don't need to be told where the problem is
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and production deployment workflows
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work in a distributed team


Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with LLMs, RAG architectures, or AI agent systems
  • Familiarity with vector databases and semantic search (e.g. OpenSearch)
  • Experience with real-time interfaces (WebSockets, streaming, SSE)
  • Background in enterprise SaaS platforms
  • Experience with Vercel for frontend hosting and deployment
  • Knowledge of authentication systems (e.g. Clerk, Auth0)
  • Knowledge of security best practices and compliance (SOC 2 is a plus)
  • Experience working with high-scale or high-availability systems


What We Offer

  • Work on cutting-edge AI systems used by enterprise customers
  • High-impact role with ownership across the full stack
  • Flexible remote work (Worldwide)
  • Direct collaboration with experienced engineers and founders
  • Fast-paced environment with real production challenges
  • Strong influence on technical and product decisions


Location Remote (Worldwide)

Hiring Model Contractor


How to Apply Please reply here with your CV or portfolio. If you enjoy building serious full-stack systems for real AI products — from the Python services that power intelligent workflows to the React interfaces that put them in users' hands — we'd love to hear from you.

title: Analista de Cyber Security Governance
description:
Analista de Cyber Security Governance

Estamos apoiando uma empresa do setor médico de ensino em forte crescimento na busca por um Analista de Cyber Security para a estratégia de segurança da informação, garantindo proteção dos dados, conformidade regulatória e gestão de riscos cibernéticos.


Esse profissional será responsável pelo apoio na implementação e operação da governança de segurança e dos mecanismos técnicos de segurança, ajudando a proteger sistemas, dados e infraestrutura da organização.


Responsabilidades


Em conjunto com times de infraestrutura, cloud e desenvolvimento :

• Apoiar nos processos de IAM (Identity and Access Management) para usuários, prestadores e sistemas

• Apoiar na implementação de controles de acesso, autenticação e gestão de privilégios

• Apoiar na execução de hardening de servidores, endpoints e ambientes cloud, reduzindo superfícies de ataque

• Apoiar a implementação de ferramentas de DLP (Data Loss Prevention) para proteção de dados sensíveis

• Definir e manter políticas, normas e frameworks de Segurança da Informação

• Analisar logs de segurança e indicadores de possível comprometimento

• Apoiar o processo de resposta a incidentes de segurança

• Liderar iniciativas de LGPD e proteção de dados junto ao DPO e áreas de negócio

• Estruturar e manter inventário de ativos de informação e classificação de dados

• Desenvolver e testar planos de resposta a incidentes e continuidade de segurança

• Liderar processos de gestão e investigação de incidentes de segurança

• Apoiar a organização na adoção de frameworks de segurança reconhecidos (NIST / ISO 27001)

• Definir métricas, indicadores e relatórios executivos de segurança (KPIs/KRIs)

• Atuar como ponte entre áreas de tecnologia, compliance, jurídico e negócios


Requisitos

• Experiência em Governança de Segurança da Informação / Cybersecurity

• Experiência em gestão de risco e compliance em segurança

• Conhecimento prático de LGPD e privacidade de dados

• Experiência com auditorias e frameworks de segurança (ISO 27001, NIST, CIS Controls ou similares)

• Experiência com gestão de incidentes de segurança

• Conhecimento em gestão de risco de terceiros e fornecedores

• Experiência em programas de conscientização de segurança

• Experiência com IAM / gestão de identidades e acessos

• Conhecimento em DLP e proteção de dados sensíveis

• Conhecimento em hardening de sistemas e servidores

• Experiência em Cybersecurity Operations / Security Engineering


Diferenciais

• Experiência no setor de saúde ou ambientes regulados

• Certificações como CISSP, CISM, CRISC, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer ou Lead Auditor

• Experiência com GRC tools ou plataformas de gestão de risco

• Conhecimento em cloud security (AWS)

• Conhecimento em Zero Trust Architecture

• Certificações como Security+, CySA+, SC-200, SC-300, CEH ou similares


Perfil desejado

• Forte habilidade de comunicação com liderança executiva

• Perfil colaborativo e orientado a cultura de segurança
