title: (Sr.) Enterprise Account Executive, DACH
description:
(Remote innerhalb der EU – Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau/C2 & fließendes Englisch)


ÜBER LEVITY:

Levity ist eine No-Code-KI-Automatisierungsplattform, die es Unternehmen ermöglicht, KI-gestützte Workflows zu entwickeln und einzusetzen, ohne Programmierkenntnisse zu benötigen. Levity unterstützt Teams dabei, wiederkehrende operative Aufgaben wie die Verarbeitung von E-Mails, Dokumenten, Bildern und Kundenanfragen zu automatisieren, indem KI-Modelle mit ihren eigenen Daten trainiert werden.

Levity wurde 2018 gegründet, hat 10 Mio. USD eingesammelt und wird von führenden Investoren unterstützt, darunter Balderton Capital, eine der renommiertesten Venture-Capital-Gesellschaften Europas, sowie Angular Ventures. 

Mit HQ in Deutschland und Chicago und einer globalen Präsenz ist die Plattform darauf ausgelegt, KI auch für nicht-technische Teams zugänglich zu machen, indem sie die Erstellung und Implementierung von Automatisierungen über eine einfache visuelle Benutzeroberfläche ermöglicht. Dadurch können Unternehmen ihre Workflows optimieren, manuelle Arbeit reduzieren und die operative Effizienz in Bereichen wie Operations, Customer Support und Backoffice-Prozessen steigern. Levity wird insbesondere von weltweit führenden Logistikunternehmen eingesetzt.

Einfach gesagt: Levity ermöglicht es Unternehmen, komplexe Geschäftsprozesse mithilfe von KI zu automatisieren – ganz ohne Engineers.


ÜBER DIE ROLLE DES ENTERPRISE ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE:

Wir suchen einen (Sr.) Enterprise Account Executive , der ein neues Geschäft vorantreibt und strategische Partnerschaften mit globalen Marktführern in der Logistik aufbaut. Du bist verantwortlich für die Identifikation, Ansprache und den Abschluss von hochkarätigen Enterprise-Kunden, mit dem Ziel, langfristige Partnerschaften im Multi-Millionen-Dollar-Bereich aufzubauen.

Dies ist eine kommerzielle Rolle mit großem Einfluss, mit Fokus auf das Navigieren in komplexen multinationalen Organisationen, das Identifizieren wertvoller Use Cases und das Generieren signifikanter neuer Umsätze. Die Position berichtet direkt an die Gründer.


Wesentliche Verantwortlichkeiten

• Enterprise Sales Ownership: Du verantwortest den gesamten Sales Cycle für strategische Enterprise-Prospects, von der ersten Ansprache und Discovery bis hin zu Verhandlung und Abschluss.

• New Revenue Generation: Du identifizierst und gewinnst neue Enterprise-Kunden, mit Fokus auf wirkungsstarke Use Cases und groß angelegte Deployments.

• Stakeholder Management: Du bewegst dich sicher in komplexen Organisationsstrukturen und baust Beziehungen zu C-Level Executives, Entscheidungsträgern und operativen Führungskräften über verschiedene Tochtergesellschaften und Länder hinweg auf.

• Commercial Strategy: Du führst kommerzielle Gespräche, entwickelst maßgeschneiderte Angebote und verhandelst Verträge, um langfristige Enterprise-Partnerschaften zu sichern.

• Collaboration: Du arbeitest während des Sales-Prozesses eng mit Solutions Engineers und Produktteams zusammen, um Lösungen zu gestalten, die den Kundenanforderungen entsprechen und gleichzeitig erfolgreiche Abschlüsse ermöglichen.


Wen wir suchen und wer in dieser Rolle erfolgreich sein wird:

• Experience: 5+ Jahre Erfahrung als Enterprise Account Executive oder im Vertrieb, mit einer starken Erfolgsbilanz beim Abschluss komplexer Deals innerhalb multinationaler Organisationen.

 • Startup DNA: Erfahrung in einem wachstumsstarken Startup-Umfeld ist essenziell. Du musst dich wohl damit fühlen, ohne die Ressourcen eines Großkonzerns zu arbeiten. Du bist hands-on und bringst eine ausgeprägte Ownership-Mentalität mit.

• Technically competent to navigate AI discussions: Auch wenn du kein Engineer bist, wirst du mit technischen Führungskräften, Operations-Leads und deren Teams sprechen und ihnen vermitteln, welchen enormen Mehrwert Levity für ihre Organisation schaffen kann. Deshalb brauchst du ein solides Verständnis von KI sowie ein gutes technisches Grundverständnis.

• Language: Deutsch auf Muttersprachiveau/C2 und fließendes Englisch. 

• Industry Background: Ein großes Plus ist Erfahrung im Vertrieb an Unternehmen aus den Bereichen Logistik, Supply Chain oder 3PL. Gleichzeitig sind wir offen für Top-Performer aus anderen komplexen Branchen, z. B. Telco, Manufacturing etc.

• Gemeinsam mit den Gründern wirst du zudem das Gesicht von Levity auf Konferenzen und Events sein. Du solltest gerne reisen, um an Konferenzen teilzunehmen und Kunden weltweit zu besuchen. Die meisten Konferenzen finden in Europa und den USA statt, während sich die Kunden global verteilen. Es wird keine monatlich feste Reisetätigkeit geben, aber einige Monate werden reiseintensiver sein als andere.


Vergütung & Benefits:

• Target Earnings: Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt mit Fixum + Bonus + Equity.

• Incentives: Ungedeckeltes Provisionsmodell mit starkem Fokus auf Expansion Revenue.

• Impact: Direkter Zugang zum Leadership-Team und die Möglichkeit, unseren Enterprise-Sales-Playbook aktiv mitzugestalten.

• International team: Levity zählt über 20 talentierte Mitarbeitende und wächst weiter. Das Team ist in Europa (Deutschland, Spanien, Portugal, Polen, Schweden), Brasilien, APAC und weiteren Regionen vertreten.

• Remote: Du kannst von überall in Europa aus arbeiten. Levity hat außerdem ein Büro in Berlin, falls du eine hybride oder Office-basierte Rolle bevorzugst.

title: Engenheiro(a) de Dados Jr - Collect & Ingestion
description:
A JUIT é uma legaltech (startup do ramo jurídico). Nosso objetivo é otimizar a pesquisa jurídica para operadores do direito, estruturando dados do Judiciário brasileiro em uma plataforma de busca e jurimetria.

Iniciamos nossas atividades em 2018 e desde então já tivemos diversos reconhecimentos, seja em inovação ou na área de tecnologia.


Vaga

A equipe de Engenharia de Dados da JUIT concentra-se em estruturar e potencializar grandes volumes de dados jurídicos provenientes de múltiplas fontes públicas e privadas. Por meio de arquiteturas robustas, pipelines escaláveis e técnicas avançadas de processamento de dados, o time transforma informações brutas e heterogêneas em ativos confiáveis, estruturados e prontos para geração de valor.

Nossa engenharia atua em todo o ciclo de vida do dado: da coleta e ingestão, passando por tratamento, normalização e enriquecimento, com pipelines de IA, até a disponibilização para produtos, API's e modelos inteligentes. Trabalhamos continuamente para elevar a qualidade, a consistência e a rastreabilidade das informações, garantindo que cada dado entregue pela JUIT contribua diretamente para decisões mais seguras, eficientes e estratégicas no contexto jurídico.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados Jr para fazer parte do nosso time de coleta e ingestão de dados (Collect & Ingestion). 


ATENÇÃO: Candidatos fora do perfil serão ignorados.


O que você fará:

  • Desenvolver soluções para coleta e ingestão de dados;
  • Atuar em conjunto com nosso time de engenharia para publicar serviços de dados para uso interno e externo de forma escalável e observável;
  • Coletar, mapear e analisar dados de diversas fontes, estruturadas ou não;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com nosso time de segurança para garantir políticas de segurança de dados e compliance;
  • Desenvolver frameworks de testes para melhorar e garantir a qualidade dos dados coletados;
  • Monitorar e documentar o status de scrapers em produção e soluções já implantadas;
  • Definir e implementar métricas para monitoramento de cargas de trabalho, alinhadas aos frameworks utilizados, incluindo indicadores de SLA, SLO e SLI, para garantir observabilidade e desempenho consistente.


Requisitos:

  • Formação superior em exatas (Ciências da computação, engenharia ou áreas relacionadas);
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em Python (2+ anos de experiência);
  • Conhecimentos em linguagem SQL (+1 anos de experiência);
  • Experiência com coleta de dados da web (web scraping, web crawling, RESTful API’s, datasets públicos);
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em algoritmos e estruturas de dados;
  • Conhecimentos em desenvolvimento orientado a testes (TDD);
  • Conhecimentos em Docker;
  • Inglês intermediário.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com processamento e extração de dados de documentos (.DOCs, .RTFs, .PDFs, etc);
  • Experiência com motores de busca de texto como Elasticsearch, Solr, OpenSearch, Sphinx, Amazon CloudSearch, Vespa e afins;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento nas linguagens Golang e/ou Rust;
  • Experiência com pelo menos uma linguagem de programação baseada na JVM (Java, Scala, Clojure, etc.);
  • Experiência com Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform, Pulumi, Chef, Ansible, etc.);
  • Experiência com coleta de dados de mídia (áudio e vídeo) e sua transcrição para texto;
  • Experiência com Kubernetes.


Período: Integral

Modelo de trabalho: Remoto

title: Analista de Cyber Security Governance
description:
Analista de Cyber Security Governance


Modelo: PJ

Local de trabalho : Remoto


Estamos apoiando uma empresa do setor médico de ensino em forte crescimento na busca por um Analista de Cyber Security para a estratégia de segurança da informação, garantindo proteção dos dados, conformidade regulatória e gestão de riscos cibernéticos.


Esse profissional será responsável pelo apoio na implementação e operação da governança de segurança e dos mecanismos técnicos de segurança, ajudando a proteger sistemas, dados e infraestrutura da organização.


Responsabilidades


Em conjunto com times de infraestrutura, cloud e desenvolvimento :

• Apoiar nos processos de IAM (Identity and Access Management) para usuários, prestadores e sistemas

• Apoiar na implementação de controles de acesso, autenticação e gestão de privilégios

• Apoiar na execução de hardening de servidores, endpoints e ambientes cloud, reduzindo superfícies de ataque

• Apoiar a implementação de ferramentas de DLP (Data Loss Prevention) para proteção de dados sensíveis

• Definir e manter políticas, normas e frameworks de Segurança da Informação

• Monitorar e investigar eventos de segurança via SIEM (Security Information and Event Management)

• Analisar logs de segurança e indicadores de possível comprometimento

• Apoiar o processo de resposta a incidentes de segurança

• Liderar iniciativas de LGPD e proteção de dados junto ao DPO e áreas de negócio

• Estruturar e conduzir gestão de riscos cibernéticos e avaliações de risco

• Coordenar auditorias internas e externas relacionadas à segurança da informação

• Implementar e evoluir processos de gestão de terceiros e riscos de fornecedores (Third Party Risk)

• Desenvolver programas de awareness e cultura de segurança para colaboradores

• Estruturar e manter inventário de ativos de informação e classificação de dados

• Desenvolver e testar planos de resposta a incidentes e continuidade de segurança

• Liderar processos de gestão e investigação de incidentes de segurança

• Apoiar a organização na adoção de frameworks de segurança reconhecidos (NIST / ISO 27001)

• Definir métricas, indicadores e relatórios executivos de segurança (KPIs/KRIs)

• Atuar como ponte entre áreas de tecnologia, compliance, jurídico e negócios


Requisitos

• Experiência em Governança de Segurança da Informação / Cybersecurity

• Experiência em gestão de risco e compliance em segurança

• Conhecimento prático de LGPD e privacidade de dados

• Experiência com auditorias e frameworks de segurança (ISO 27001, NIST, CIS Controls ou similares)

• Experiência com gestão de incidentes de segurança

• Conhecimento em gestão de risco de terceiros e fornecedores

• Experiência em programas de conscientização de segurança

• Experiência com IAM / gestão de identidades e acessos

• Conhecimento em DLP e proteção de dados sensíveis

• Conhecimento em hardening de sistemas e servidores

• Experiência em Cybersecurity Operations / Security Engineering


Diferenciais

• Experiência no setor de saúde ou ambientes regulados

• Certificações como CISSP, CISM, CRISC, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer ou Lead Auditor

• Experiência com GRC tools ou plataformas de gestão de risco

• Conhecimento em cloud security (AWS)

• Conhecimento em Zero Trust Architecture

• Certificações como Security+, CySA+, SC-200, SC-300, CEH ou similares


Perfil desejado

• Forte habilidade de comunicação com liderança executiva

• Perfil colaborativo e orientado a cultura de segurança

title: (Sr.) Enterprise Account Executive, DACH
description:
(Remote innerhalb der EU – Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau/C2 & fließendes Englisch)


ÜBER LEVITY:

Levity ist eine No-Code-KI-Automatisierungsplattform, die es Unternehmen ermöglicht, KI-gestützte Workflows zu entwickeln und einzusetzen, ohne Programmierkenntnisse zu benötigen. Levity unterstützt Teams dabei, wiederkehrende operative Aufgaben wie die Verarbeitung von E-Mails, Dokumenten, Bildern und Kundenanfragen zu automatisieren, indem KI-Modelle mit ihren eigenen Daten trainiert werden.

Levity wurde 2018 gegründet, hat 10 Mio. USD eingesammelt und wird von führenden Investoren unterstützt, darunter Balderton Capital, eine der renommiertesten Venture-Capital-Gesellschaften Europas, sowie Angular Ventures. 

Mit HQ in Deutschland und Chicago und einer globalen Präsenz ist die Plattform darauf ausgelegt, KI auch für nicht-technische Teams zugänglich zu machen, indem sie die Erstellung und Implementierung von Automatisierungen über eine einfache visuelle Benutzeroberfläche ermöglicht. Dadurch können Unternehmen ihre Workflows optimieren, manuelle Arbeit reduzieren und die operative Effizienz in Bereichen wie Operations, Customer Support und Backoffice-Prozessen steigern. Levity wird insbesondere von weltweit führenden Logistikunternehmen eingesetzt.

Einfach gesagt: Levity ermöglicht es Unternehmen, komplexe Geschäftsprozesse mithilfe von KI zu automatisieren – ganz ohne Engineers.


ÜBER DIE ROLLE DES ENTERPRISE ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE:

Wir suchen einen (Sr.) Enterprise Account Executive , der ein neues Geschäft vorantreibt und strategische Partnerschaften mit globalen Marktführern in der Logistik aufbaut. Du bist verantwortlich für die Identifikation, Ansprache und den Abschluss von hochkarätigen Enterprise-Kunden, mit dem Ziel, langfristige Partnerschaften im Multi-Millionen-Dollar-Bereich aufzubauen.

Dies ist eine kommerzielle Rolle mit großem Einfluss, mit Fokus auf das Navigieren in komplexen multinationalen Organisationen, das Identifizieren wertvoller Use Cases und das Generieren signifikanter neuer Umsätze. Die Position berichtet direkt an die Gründer.


Wesentliche Verantwortlichkeiten

• Enterprise Sales Ownership: Du verantwortest den gesamten Sales Cycle für strategische Enterprise-Prospects, von der ersten Ansprache und Discovery bis hin zu Verhandlung und Abschluss.

• New Revenue Generation: Du identifizierst und gewinnst neue Enterprise-Kunden, mit Fokus auf wirkungsstarke Use Cases und groß angelegte Deployments.

• Stakeholder Management: Du bewegst dich sicher in komplexen Organisationsstrukturen und baust Beziehungen zu C-Level Executives, Entscheidungsträgern und operativen Führungskräften über verschiedene Tochtergesellschaften und Länder hinweg auf.

• Commercial Strategy: Du führst kommerzielle Gespräche, entwickelst maßgeschneiderte Angebote und verhandelst Verträge, um langfristige Enterprise-Partnerschaften zu sichern.

• Collaboration: Du arbeitest während des Sales-Prozesses eng mit Solutions Engineers und Produktteams zusammen, um Lösungen zu gestalten, die den Kundenanforderungen entsprechen und gleichzeitig erfolgreiche Abschlüsse ermöglichen.


Wen wir suchen und wer in dieser Rolle erfolgreich sein wird:

• Experience: 5+ Jahre Erfahrung als Enterprise Account Executive oder im Vertrieb, mit einer starken Erfolgsbilanz beim Abschluss komplexer Deals innerhalb multinationaler Organisationen.

 • Startup DNA: Erfahrung in einem wachstumsstarken Startup-Umfeld ist essenziell. Du musst dich wohl damit fühlen, ohne die Ressourcen eines Großkonzerns zu arbeiten. Du bist hands-on und bringst eine ausgeprägte Ownership-Mentalität mit.

• Technically competent to navigate AI discussions: Auch wenn du kein Engineer bist, wirst du mit technischen Führungskräften, Operations-Leads und deren Teams sprechen und ihnen vermitteln, welchen enormen Mehrwert Levity für ihre Organisation schaffen kann. Deshalb brauchst du ein solides Verständnis von KI sowie ein gutes technisches Grundverständnis.

• Language: Deutsch auf Muttersprachiveau/C2 und fließendes Englisch. 

• Industry Background: Ein großes Plus ist Erfahrung im Vertrieb an Unternehmen aus den Bereichen Logistik, Supply Chain oder 3PL. Gleichzeitig sind wir offen für Top-Performer aus anderen komplexen Branchen, z. B. Telco, Manufacturing etc.

• Gemeinsam mit den Gründern wirst du zudem das Gesicht von Levity auf Konferenzen und Events sein. Du solltest gerne reisen, um an Konferenzen teilzunehmen und Kunden weltweit zu besuchen. Die meisten Konferenzen finden in Europa und den USA statt, während sich die Kunden global verteilen. Es wird keine monatlich feste Reisetätigkeit geben, aber einige Monate werden reiseintensiver sein als andere.


Vergütung & Benefits:

• Target Earnings: Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt mit Fixum + Bonus + Equity.

• Incentives: Ungedeckeltes Provisionsmodell mit starkem Fokus auf Expansion Revenue.

• Impact: Direkter Zugang zum Leadership-Team und die Möglichkeit, unseren Enterprise-Sales-Playbook aktiv mitzugestalten.

• International team: Levity zählt über 20 talentierte Mitarbeitende und wächst weiter. Das Team ist in Europa (Deutschland, Spanien, Portugal, Polen, Schweden), Brasilien, APAC und weiteren Regionen vertreten.

• Remote: Du kannst von überall in Europa aus arbeiten. Levity hat außerdem ein Büro in Berlin, falls du eine hybride oder Office-basierte Rolle bevorzugst.

• Travel: Du solltest dich mit umfangreicher Reisetätigkeit wohlfühlen, um Kunden weltweit zu treffen und bei Bedarf an Konferenzen teilzunehmen.


Additional notes:

  • Interview will be conducted in English, as the language is mandatory for this role
  • All applicants are carefully reviewed by our team daily and if we see a strong match to the role, you will be contacted via LinkedIn or e-mail.
  •  If you're not contacted, we believe it's not a match this time and will keep you in mind for future opportunities.

title: Analista de Cyber Security Governance
description:
Analista de Cyber Security Governance


Modelo: PJ

Local de trabalho : Remoto


Estamos apoiando uma empresa do setor médico de ensino em forte crescimento na busca por um Analista de Cyber Security para a estratégia de segurança da informação, garantindo proteção dos dados, conformidade regulatória e gestão de riscos cibernéticos.


Esse profissional será responsável pelo apoio na implementação e operação da governança de segurança e dos mecanismos técnicos de segurança, ajudando a proteger sistemas, dados e infraestrutura da organização.


Responsabilidades


Em conjunto com times de infraestrutura, cloud e desenvolvimento :

• Apoiar nos processos de IAM (Identity and Access Management) para usuários, prestadores e sistemas

• Apoiar na implementação de controles de acesso, autenticação e gestão de privilégios

• Apoiar na execução de hardening de servidores, endpoints e ambientes cloud, reduzindo superfícies de ataque

• Apoiar a implementação de ferramentas de DLP (Data Loss Prevention) para proteção de dados sensíveis

• Definir e manter políticas, normas e frameworks de Segurança da Informação

• Monitorar e investigar eventos de segurança via SIEM (Security Information and Event Management)

• Analisar logs de segurança e indicadores de possível comprometimento

• Apoiar o processo de resposta a incidentes de segurança

• Liderar iniciativas de LGPD e proteção de dados junto ao DPO e áreas de negócio

• Estruturar e conduzir gestão de riscos cibernéticos e avaliações de risco

• Coordenar auditorias internas e externas relacionadas à segurança da informação

• Implementar e evoluir processos de gestão de terceiros e riscos de fornecedores (Third Party Risk)

• Desenvolver programas de awareness e cultura de segurança para colaboradores

• Estruturar e manter inventário de ativos de informação e classificação de dados

• Desenvolver e testar planos de resposta a incidentes e continuidade de segurança

• Liderar processos de gestão e investigação de incidentes de segurança

• Apoiar a organização na adoção de frameworks de segurança reconhecidos (NIST / ISO 27001)

• Definir métricas, indicadores e relatórios executivos de segurança (KPIs/KRIs)

• Atuar como ponte entre áreas de tecnologia, compliance, jurídico e negócios


Requisitos

• Experiência em Governança de Segurança da Informação / Cybersecurity

• Experiência em gestão de risco e compliance em segurança

• Conhecimento prático de LGPD e privacidade de dados

• Experiência com auditorias e frameworks de segurança (ISO 27001, NIST, CIS Controls ou similares)

• Experiência com gestão de incidentes de segurança

• Conhecimento em gestão de risco de terceiros e fornecedores

• Experiência em programas de conscientização de segurança

• Experiência com IAM / gestão de identidades e acessos

• Conhecimento em DLP e proteção de dados sensíveis

• Conhecimento em hardening de sistemas e servidores

• Experiência em Cybersecurity Operations / Security Engineering


Diferenciais

• Experiência no setor de saúde ou ambientes regulados

• Certificações como CISSP, CISM, CRISC, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer ou Lead Auditor

• Experiência com GRC tools ou plataformas de gestão de risco

• Conhecimento em cloud security (AWS)

• Conhecimento em Zero Trust Architecture

• Certificações como Security+, CySA+, SC-200, SC-300, CEH ou similares


Perfil desejado

• Forte habilidade de comunicação com liderança executiva

• Perfil colaborativo e orientado a cultura de segurança

title: Desenvolvedor full stack
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Detalhes da oportunidade:

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor Fullstack altamente qualificado(a), com forte expertise em testes automatizados, desenvolvimento backend utilizando tecnologias modernas .NET e experiência prática com serviços em nuvem Azure.


Responsabilidades:

  • Construir toda a infraestrutura de testes do projeto
  • Escrever testes unitários, integração e E2E
  • Implementar e manter mocks (NSubstitute)
  • Gerar e analisar relatórios de cobertura
  • Configurar pipelines com GitHub Actions
  • Garantir que a suíte de testes permaneça estável, confiável e saudável


Requisitos:

  • Experiência sólida na construção e manutenção de infraestrutura de testes
  • Forte conhecimento em Testes Unitários, Testes de Integração e Testes Funcionais (E2E)
  • Proficiência com NSubstitute para criação de mocks
  • Capacidade de escrever, executar e depurar testes automatizados
  • Experiência na geração e comunicação de relatórios de cobertura de testes
  • Experiência no uso do GitHub como plataforma de controle de versão
  • Experiência prática na configuração e manutenção de GitHub Actions para execução automatizada de testes e workflows de CI
  • Capacidade comprovada de garantir a manutenibilidade e confiabilidade das suítes de testes
  • Forte experiência com C#
  • Proficiência em .NET 8 / .NET 9 / .NET 10
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de APIs minimalistas (Minimal APIs)
  • Forte entendimento de OpenAPI (Swagger)
  • Experiência trabalhando com Blazor
  • Proficiência com Entity Framework Core (EF Core)
  • Forte experiência com SQL Server.
  • Experiência com Azure Service Bus
  • Conhecimento prático de Azure Functions
  • Experiência com Azure Cosmos DB
  • Experiência prática com logging distribuído
  • Experiência na implementação e uso de OpenTelemetry
  • Inglês fluente
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma eficaz com equipes multidisciplinares

title: Amazon Graphic Designer / Creative Strategist
description:
We are hiring an Amazon Graphic Designer to own the strategic development and execution of premium marketplace creatives.


This is not a task-based production role. We are looking for someone who can think strategically, identify what needs to improve visually without being told, build creative briefs from product and customer analysis, and bring ideas from concept through implementation .


The right person understands that great Amazon creative is not just about making listings look better. It is about increasing click-through rate, improving conversion rate, answering buyer decision questions visually, and creating a premium brand experience that feels custom, polished, and mobile-first.



What You’ll Own


You will lead design for:

  • CTR-optimized main images
  • Amazon infographics
  • A+ Content
  • Amazon Brand Stores
  • Amazon ad creatives



What You’ll Be Responsible For


  • Develop high-converting Amazon creative that is visually premium, detail-oriented, mobile-optimized, and aligned to each brand’s positioning
  • Translate product analysis, competitor analysis, review mining, and buyer research into strong visual concepts
  • Build creative briefs independently based on our internal product analysis process
  • Create designs that clearly answer buyer decision questions using strong hierarchy, thoughtful white space, and strategic visual storytelling
  • Use design flow intentionally in A+ Content and Brand Stores to guide the shopper’s eye and improve engagement
  • Identify visual weaknesses and missed opportunities in product listings without needing step-by-step direction
  • Recommend what should be improved across images, modules, storefronts, and ad creatives based on conversion principles
  • Bring ideas from ideation to execution, including concepting, layout, design, revision, and final production-ready files
  • Leverage AI tools to augment product photography, generate lifestyle imagery, and accelerate creative workflows while maintaining a premium, realistic output
  • Ensure all work is marketplace-compliant, polished, and built for conversion
  • Self-audit all work for alignment, consistency, accuracy, realism, proportion, mobile readability, and premium brand presentation
  • Partner with strategy and account teams to prioritize the highest-impact visual opportunities
  • Support A/B testing initiatives and use testing data to inform creative recommendations



What We’re Looking For


  • 5+ years of graphic design experience
  • Strong portfolio of ecommerce design work
  • Strong understanding of Amazon , including the role of main images, image sequencing, A+ flow, and Store navigation
  • Ability to work independently and proactively
  • Strong eye for layout, hierarchy, whitespace, typography, composition, and premium visual presentation
  • Deep attention to detail & your superpower is communication
  • Experience collaborating in a fast-paced environment



Required Skills


  • Expert-level proficiency in Adobe Photoshop
  • Strong working knowledge of design and organizational tools like Figma, Asana, Trello
  • Experience with AI design tools, including Nano Banana, Scalable or comparable
  • Familiarity with A/B testing workflows for creative



What Great Looks Like in This Role


  • You can look at a listing and quickly identify what is hurting CTR or conversion
  • You know how to visually communicate product value without overloading the image
  • You understand how to make creative feel premium, not generic
  • You use AI as an enhancement tool, not a shortcut for low-quality work
  • You care about the details that separate average creative from exceptional creative



Why Work With Us


  • High-impact creative: Your work directly influences CTR, CVR, and revenue


  • Growth-focused brands: Not low-quality, mass-production design work


  • Competitive Salary: Up to $3,000/mo depending on experience and expertise.


  • 100% Remote: Work from anywhere in the world, as long as you have a strong internet signal.


  • Work Hours: 9AM–5PM CST


  • Growth Opportunities: Be one of our first 10 hires and play a key role in shaping our processes, culture, and future. Grow with an agency that values proactive thinkers, ownership mentality, and people-first leadership.


  • Learn cutting-edge Amazon growth strategies from ex-Amazon employees and industry pros.



To Apply


Don’t just apply here on LinkedIn - Send your resume, portfolio, and a short note telling us why you're the perfect creative and strategic mind to grow our clients’ visual brands to: with subject line: Creative Director – Your Name

title: Performance Marketing Analyst
description:
We’re looking for a Paid Media Marketing Specialist to drive high-quality leads by creating, managing, and measuring Digital Marketing campaigns across Google, YouTube, social, and other relevant channels.


About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market. Our SaaS products power tens of millions of conversations monthly, helping real estate professionals close more deals using text and voice.


The ideal candidate is a hands-on, independent strategic thinker who brings deep expertise in running digital marketing programs and developing digital marketing assets (with our designer) within B2B SaaS organizations.


If you’re used to depending on task queues, waiting for someone to tell you what to do, or only being reactive instead of mostly proactive, this isn’t the role for you. But if you have a bias for execution and love taking ownership of outcomes — keep reading.


What You’ll Own:

  • Develop programs and strategies for customer acquisition, retention, and expansion through multiple channels, including search, PMAX, social, retargeting, content (written and video), and more.
  • Define KPIs and implement measurement, analytics, benchmarking, and reporting methods to gauge success for marketing channels, campaigns, and initiatives.
  • Drive continual improvements in lead conversion rates and revenue close rates.
  • Continue to scale our marketing efforts and take primary responsibility for exceeding our KPIs for each quarter.
  • Work closely with the overall Marketing team to define required assets such as content, images, video, etc.

description:

CoHostly is a growing SaaS company focused on building software and systems that solve real operational problems in the rental car space. We are looking for a high-level operator who can help turn a fast-moving company into a more structured, scalable business.

This is not a normal job. This is a high-ownership role for someone who wants to help build something meaningful from the ground up and work directly with the founder to drive execution, growth, and long-term value.


About the role

We are hiring a Founding General Manager / Operating Partner to help lead execution across the business. This person will help bring structure, accountability, and momentum to CoHostly while taking a major load off the founder.

This role is ideal for someone who is strong in operations, growth, sales support, team coordination, and making things happen in early-stage environments.


What you’ll be responsible for

  • Help run day-to-day execution across the business
  • Build structure, systems, and accountability around priorities
  • Coordinate projects across product, operations, sales, and growth
  • Work closely with the founder to turn ideas into execution
  • Help manage contractors, remote team members, and key initiatives
  • Support customer onboarding, retention, and feedback loops
  • Help identify bottlenecks, solve problems, and keep the company moving fast
  • Create visibility around KPIs, priorities, and weekly progress
  • Contribute to growth efforts including partnerships, outbound support, and business development initiatives


Who we’re looking for

  • Strong operator with experience in startups, SaaS, fintech, marketplaces, or high-growth businesses
  • Highly organized and execution-focused
  • Able to work directly with a founder and thrive in a fast-moving environment
  • Strong communicator who can manage moving pieces and drive progress
  • Comfortable wearing multiple hats across ops, growth, sales support, and team coordination
  • Resourceful, proactive, and able to solve problems without constant direction
  • Serious about building, not just collecting a paycheck


Preferred background

  • Experience working in a startup or early-stage company
  • Experience in business operations, product operations, general management, chief of staff, or growth
  • Experience helping scale teams, systems, or revenue
  • Experience managing remote teams or contractors
  • Bonus if you have experience in SaaS, fintech, automotive, fleet, or marketplace businesses


What success looks like

In the first 90 days, you should be able to:

  • create more structure and accountability across the business
  • improve execution speed
  • organize priorities and workflows
  • help move key growth and product initiatives forward
  • increase revenue and sales
  • make the company easier to run and easier to scale


Compensation

Compensation will depend on experience and background. This role includes base compensation with performance-based upside. Long-term incentive or equity potential may be available for the right person after proven execution.


How to apply

Please send:

  • your resume
  • a short intro about your background
  • 2–3 examples of similar work you’ve done
  • a brief explanation of why you’re a strong fit for this role

We are looking for someone sharp, reliable, and high-level. Remote is fine. Overseas is fine. What matters most is that you can execute.

title: (Sr.) Enterprise Account Manager, DACH
description:
(Remote innerhalb der EU – Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau/C2 & fließendes Englisch)


ÜBER LEVITY

Levity ist eine No-Code-KI-Automatisierungsplattform, die es Unternehmen ermöglicht, KI-gestützte Workflows zu entwickeln und einzusetzen, ohne Programmierkenntnisse zu benötigen. Levity unterstützt Teams dabei, wiederkehrende operative Aufgaben wie die Verarbeitung von E-Mails, Dokumenten, Bildern und Kundenanfragen zu automatisieren, indem KI-Modelle mit ihren eigenen Daten trainiert werden.

Levity wurde 2018 gegründet, hat 10 Mio. USD eingesammelt und wird von führenden Investoren unterstützt, darunter Balderton Capital sowie Angular Ventures. Mit Hauptsitzen in Deutschland und Chicago ist die Plattform darauf ausgelegt, KI auch für nicht-technische Teams zugänglich zu machen. Dadurch können Unternehmen ihre operative Effizienz in Bereichen wie Operations, Customer Support und Backoffice-Prozessen massiv steigern. Levity wird insbesondere von weltweit führenden Logistikunternehmen eingesetzt.

Einfach gesagt: Levity ermöglicht es Unternehmen, komplexe Geschäftsprozesse mithilfe von KI zu automatisieren – ganz ohne Engineers.


ÜBER DIE ROLLE

Wir suchen einen (Sr.) Enterprise Account Manager , der die strategisch wichtigsten Kundenbeziehungen von Levity mit globalen Logistikführern verantwortet und ausbaut (z. B. Gebrüder Weiss, LKW Walter). Du übernimmst Accounts nach dem Sales-Abschluss mit dem Ziel, daraus Partnerschaften im Multi-Millionen-Dollar-Bereich zu entwickeln.

Dies ist keine rein administrative Bestandskundenrolle. Es ist eine kommerzielle Position mit hohem Impact, Fokus auf das Navigieren in komplexen multinationalen Organisationen und das Vorantreiben signifikanter Umsatzexpansion. Die Position berichtet direkt an die Gründer.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Strategic Account Ownership: Du verantwortest ein fokussiertes Portfolio von 3 bis 5 hochwertigen Enterprise Accounts.
  • Revenue Expansion: Du treibst starkes Wachstum innerhalb bestehender Accounts voran, indem du neue Abteilungen, Regionen und Use Cases erschließt.
  • Stakeholder Management: Du analysierst komplexe Organisationsstrukturen und baust Beziehungen zu C-Level Executives sowie operativen Champions über verschiedene Tochtergesellschaften hinweg auf.
  • Commercial Strategy: Du führst Vertragsverhandlungen und Renewals und entwickelst Kunden hin zu langfristigen, großvolumigen Commitments.
  • Collaboration: Du arbeitest eng mit Solutions Engineers und Produktteams zusammen, um eine erfolgreiche Delivery sicherzustellen.
  • Travel: Regelmäßige Reisen zu Kundenstandorten (z. B. Hamburg, Wien, Belgien oder USA), um persönliche Beziehungen vor Ort zu pflegen.


DEIN PROFIL

  • Experience: 5+ Jahre Erfahrung im Enterprise Account Management oder Sales, insbesondere in der Betreuung multinationaler Accounts.
  • Startup DNA: Erfahrung in einem wachstumsstarken Umfeld ist essenziell. Du bist hands-on, denkst unternehmerisch und besitzt eine ausgeprägte Ownership-Mentalität.
  • AI & Tech Fluency: Du bist kein Engineer, kannst aber mit technischen Führungskräften auf Augenhöhe über den Nutzwert von KI-Workflows sprechen.
  • Language: Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau (C2) sowie verhandlungssicheres Englisch sind zwingende Voraussetzungen.
  • Industry Background: Erfahrung im Vertrieb an Logistik, Supply Chain oder 3PL ist ein großes Plus. Wir sind jedoch offen für Top-Performer aus anderen komplexen Branchen (Telco, Manufacturing, etc.).


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

  • Target Earnings: Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt mit Fixum + Equity.
  • Incentives: Ungedeckeltes Provisionsmodell mit starkem Fokus auf Expansion Revenue.
  • Impact: Direkter Zugang zum Leadership-Team und die Chance, unser Enterprise-Sales-Playbook aktiv mitzugestalten.
  • Flexibility: Remote-Work von überall in Europa oder hybrides Arbeiten in unserem Berliner Büro.
  • Team: Ein internationales, talentiertes Team aus über 20 Mitgliedern weltweit.


Additional notes:

  • Interview will be conducted in English, as the language is mandatory for this role
  • All applicants are carefully reviewed by our team daily and if we see a strong match to the role, you will be contacted via LinkedIn or e-mail. If you're not contacted, we believe it's not a match this time and will keep you in mind for future opportunities.

title: Desenvolvedor (a) C++
description:
Cód. 59231


Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei Dev, venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?

  • Desenvolvimento avançado em C/C++ (atuação direta no core transacional de autorizador de cartões).
  • Experiência em AWS (nível intermediário) para apoiar/implementar a modernização e migração da plataforma para cloud.
  • Conhecimentos intermediários de Linux (operação, troubleshooting e ambiente de execução).
  • Automação e infraestrutura como código : Terraform + práticas de CI/CD (nível intermediário).
  • Suporte ao ecossistema de desenvolvimento e dados : Python e SQL (nível intermediário), além de boa colaboração/proatividade e foco em performance/risco.


- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Ecommerce Growth Lead
description:
About Mimi Beds


Mimi Beds is a fast-growing children’s furniture brand inspired by Montessori principles. We design modern, safe, and thoughtfully crafted floor beds that help young children develop independence while creating beautiful spaces for families.


Our products are trusted by thousands of parents across North America and are built with a focus on quality, safety, and timeless design.


We are now looking for a Ecommerce Growth Lead to own and scale our customer acquisition and revenue growth.


Role Overview


The Growth Ecom Lead will be responsible for driving profitable growth across Mimi Beds’ digital channels. This role combines performance marketing, conversion optimization, lifecycle marketing, and data-driven experimentation.


The ideal candidate has experience scaling DTC ecommerce brands and understands how to build sustainable growth engines across paid media, organic channels, and customer retention.


This role reports directly to the leadership team and will play a key part in shaping the future of the brand.


Key Responsibilities


Growth Strategy & Leadership

  • Develop and own the overall growth strategy for Mimi Beds
  • Identify and prioritize growth opportunities across acquisition, conversion, and retention
  • Lead and coordinate marketing initiatives across paid media, content, lifecycle marketing, and partnerships
  • Provide direction and oversight to team members supporting marketing execution


Paid Media & Customer Acquisition

  • Define paid media strategy across Meta, Google, and emerging channels
  • Guide campaign strategy, audience testing, and creative experimentation
  • Monitor performance metrics and ensure profitable scaling of acquisition channels


Conversion Optimization & Ecommerce Performance

  • Lead initiatives to improve conversion rate, AOV, and overall ecommerce performance
  • Work closely with the team to test landing pages, product pages, bundles, and promotional structures
  • Identify friction points in the customer journey and implement improvements


Lifecycle Marketing & Retention

  • Oversee email and SMS marketing strategy
  • Develop initiatives to increase customer lifetime value and repeat purchases
  • Optimize lifecycle flows including welcome series, abandoned cart, and post-purchase engagement


Influencer & Creative Strategy

  • Guide the strategy for influencer partnerships and user-generated content
  • Ensure a consistent pipeline of high-performing creative for paid and organic channels
  • Collaborate with creators and internal team members to test and scale winning content


Analytics & Growth Insights

  • Track and analyze key growth metrics including:
  • Customer acquisition cost (CAC)
  • Return on ad spend (ROAS)
  • Marketing efficiency ratio (MER)
  • Conversion rate
  • Average order value
  • Translate data into clear recommendations for leadership


Qualifications


  • 7+ years of experience in growth marketing or performance marketing
  • Experience scaling DTC ecommerce brands
  • Strong experience with paid acquisition platforms (Meta, Google, TikTok)
  • Experience developing growth strategy and managing marketing initiatives
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Experience working with Shopify or ecommerce platforms

title: SAP SD Techno Functional Consultant
description:
About HCLTech


HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.


To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit


Role Overview

The SAP SD Techno‑Functional Consultant is responsible for designing, configuring, and delivering SAP Sales & Distribution solutions, along with managing technical enhancements through ABAP knowledge. The role bridges functional expertise with technical capability to support end‑to‑end sales process.


Key Responsibilities


Functional Responsibilities

  • Gather and analyze business requirements related to Order-to-Cash (OTC) and Sales & Distribution processes.
  • Configure SAP SD modules including:
  • Customer Master, Material Master, Pricing, Output Determination
  • Sales Orders, Deliveries, Billing
  • Shipping, Credit Management, Returns & Refunds
  • Availability Check (ATP), Intercompany sales, Third‑party sales
  • Design and implement pricing procedures, tax configurations, and condition techniques.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams (MM, FI, PP, WM, CRM, TM).
  • Provide support for UAT, SIT, integration testing, and Go-Live.
  • Prepare functional specifications for RICEFW objects.


Technical Responsibilities (Techno‑Functional)

  • Collaborate with ABAP developers to build and enhance custom objects.
  • Ability to debug ABAP code to perform issue analysis.
  • Create Functional Design Documents (FDD), and review Technical Design Documents (TDD).


Language Requirement:

Advanced English


Why choose us?

We are one of the largest and fastest growing technology companies in the world, with offices in over 60 countries and 224,000 employees

Our company is extremely diverse with 165 nationalities represented

We offer the opportunity to work with colleagues from all over the world

We offer a virtual-first work environment, promoting a good integration between your work and personal life, with real flexibility

We are committed to your growth, offering learning and career development opportunities at all levels to help you find your unique brilliance.


Equality & Opportunity for All

Representing 165 nationalities worldwide, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, religion, sex, color, age, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, disability or genetic information, or any other protected classification, in accordance with federal, state and/or local laws

title: Web Content Editor / Web QA (Growth Role)
description:
Location: Brazil

Team: Digital / Web


Company Description


Bucksense, Inc. is a company dedicated to bridging the gap between brands and publishers by fostering an open and trustworthy environment. We leverage creativity, skilled professionals, and advanced technology to drive marketing performance across multiple channels. Our services for brands empower businesses to take control of their digital marketing strategies, data, and outcomes, while our DirectoPub platform offers publishers innovative opportunities to optimize revenue. At Bucksense, we combine technology with human expertise to provide a unified platform for managing marketing operations effectively. Our mission is to deliver impactful results with efficiency and clarity.


Role Overview


We are seeking a digitally savvy, detail-oriented Web Content Editor with a strong interest in web quality assurance and UX excellence. This role sits at the intersection of editorial, web publishing, and QA, and is ideal for a mid-level professional who wants to grow into a QA leadership role over time.


You will be responsible for ensuring that all web content across our travel portals is clear, accurate, consistent, accessible, and presented to a high standard, while also progressively taking ownership of content-related QA processes and cross-team quality checks.


You will collaborate closely with content creators, designers, developers, and marketing teams to ensure a polished, high-quality web experience.


Key Responsibilities:


Content Editing & Publishing

  • Edit, proofread, and publish web content to ensure clarity, accuracy, grammar, and alignment with brand guidelines.
  • Maintain consistency in tone, style, formatting, and structure across pages.
  • Manage and update content within a CMS (e.g., Sanity, WordPress, or similar).
  • Coordinate content updates with writers, designers, developers, and stakeholders.
  • Maintain an editorial calendar and oversee timely content updates.


UX, Accessibility & Content Quality

  • Review content presentation across devices to ensure usability, readability, and mobile optimization.
  • Ensure accessibility best practices are followed (e.g., alt text, content structure, readability).
  • Apply UX and SEO best practices, including internal linking and content optimization.
  • Assess image quality, typography, layout, and overall visual presentation.


Web QA & Quality Ownership

  • Perform content-focused QA checks to ensure pages are published correctly and meet quality standards.
  • Identify and flag content-related issues such as broken links, formatting errors, incorrect displays, or inconsistencies.
  • Collaborate with developers and designers to resolve quality issues.
  • Contribute to the development of QA standards, checklists, and processes related to web content.
  • Gradually take increased ownership of web quality assurance as part of a long-term growth path toward QA leadership.


Performance & Optimization

  • Monitor website performance and user engagement using analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics).
  • Conduct regular content audits to identify outdated, underperforming, or improvement-ready content.
  • Recommend enhancements based on data and qualitative review.


Qualifications & Skills

  • 2+ years of experience in digital content editing, web publishing, or content operations.
  • Strong editorial skills: writing, editing, and proofreading with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Hands-on experience working with CMS platforms (Sanity, WordPress, or headless CMS).
  • Working knowledge of HTML/CSS for light formatting and layout adjustments.
  • Solid understanding of UX principles, accessibility, and mobile-first web best practices.
  • Comfort reviewing web pages for quality, consistency, and presentation issues.
  • Experience using analytics tools to assess content performance.
  • Organized, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple content workflows.
  • Interest in growing into a broader QA-focused role over time.


Nice to Have

  • Prior exposure to web QA, content QA, or digital quality processes.
  • Experience in travel, lifestyle, luxury, or e-commerce environments.
  • Familiarity with structured QA documentation or checklists.


Growth Opportunity

This role is designed to evolve over time, with the opportunity to grow into a lead QA role for web content and digital experience, helping define standards and processes across our platforms.

title: Founding General Manager / Operating Partner
description:
About CoHostly

CoHostly is a growing SaaS company focused on building software and systems that solve real operational problems in the rental car space. We are looking for a high-level operator who can help turn a fast-moving company into a more structured, scalable business.

This is not a normal job. This is a high-ownership role for someone who wants to help build something meaningful from the ground up and work directly with the founder to drive execution, growth, and long-term value.


About the role

We are hiring a Founding General Manager / Operating Partner to help lead execution across the business. This person will help bring structure, accountability, and momentum to CoHostly while taking a major load off the founder.

This role is ideal for someone who is strong in operations, growth, sales support, team coordination, and making things happen in early-stage environments.


What you’ll be responsible for

  • Help run day-to-day execution across the business
  • Build structure, systems, and accountability around priorities
  • Coordinate projects across product, operations, sales, and growth
  • Work closely with the founder to turn ideas into execution
  • Help manage contractors, remote team members, and key initiatives
  • Support customer onboarding, retention, and feedback loops
  • Help identify bottlenecks, solve problems, and keep the company moving fast
  • Create visibility around KPIs, priorities, and weekly progress
  • Contribute to growth efforts including partnerships, outbound support, and business development initiatives


Who we’re looking for

  • Strong operator with experience in startups, SaaS, fintech, marketplaces, or high-growth businesses
  • Highly organized and execution-focused
  • Able to work directly with a founder and thrive in a fast-moving environment
  • Strong communicator who can manage moving pieces and drive progress
  • Comfortable wearing multiple hats across ops, growth, sales support, and team coordination
  • Resourceful, proactive, and able to solve problems without constant direction
  • Serious about building, not just collecting a paycheck


Preferred background

  • Experience working in a startup or early-stage company
  • Experience in business operations, product operations, general management, chief of staff, or growth
  • Experience helping scale teams, systems, or revenue
  • Experience managing remote teams or contractors
  • Bonus if you have experience in SaaS, fintech, automotive, fleet, or marketplace businesses


What success looks like

In the first 90 days, you should be able to:

  • create more structure and accountability across the business
  • improve execution speed
  • organize priorities and workflows
  • help move key growth and product initiatives forward
  • increase revenue and sales
  • make the company easier to run and easier to scale


Compensation

Compensation will depend on experience and background. This role includes base compensation with performance-based upside. Long-term incentive or equity potential may be available for the right person after proven execution.


How to apply

Please send:

  • your resume
  • a short intro about your background
  • 2–3 examples of similar work you’ve done
  • a brief explanation of why you’re a strong fit for this role

We are looking for someone sharp, reliable, and high-level. Remote is fine. Overseas is fine. What matters most is that you can execute.

A client of Insight Global is seeking a highly experienced ITGC & SOX Readiness Lead to serve as the central architect and owner of our IT General Controls (ITGC) program. This is a strategic GRC role designed for a hands-on leader who goes beyond checklist testing to partner deeply with Engineering, IT, and Finance to build scalable, defensible, and audit-ready controls.

This is not an Internal Audit role. Instead, you will operate as a “Line 1.5” enablement and readiness leader, responsible for ensuring controls are properly scoped, well-designed, automated where possible, and operating effectively before Internal and External Auditors begin formal validation.

You will own the full ITGC readiness lifecycle—from scoping and control design to interim self-testing, remediation, and audit coordination—ensuring predictable outcomes and eliminating last-minute surprises.

title: Head of GTM & Growth | Valere Evolve
description:
About Valere Evolve

Valere Evolve is an AI transformation platform that accelerates AI maturity by unifying workforce education, custom development, knowledge capture, and autonomous execution into a single integrated system. Built on three connected pillars — Learn, Build, and Scale — each phase feeds directly into the next. Learning prepares the workforce. Labs builds the systems. Dactic captures institutional knowledge. Conducto orchestrates execution at scale. The result is a continuous transformation loop rather than a stack of disconnected tools and vendors. One platform. From ambition to AI-native operations.


The Role

As Head of GTM & Growth, you are the commercial engine behind Valere Evolve. You will own the full go-to-market strategy and growth execution — from market positioning and pipeline creation to partnership development and revenue scaling. This is not a planning role. You will be expected to build, launch, and iterate in market with the same hands-on urgency that defines the product itself.

You bring demonstrated experience taking AI products and platforms to market, using AI-native tools to scale your own work, and a track record of growing user bases through high-leverage execution. You have done this before. You know what it takes to move a technical platform from early adopters to scaled commercial traction, and you know how to do it with a lean, intelligent team.

This role requires the ability to execute across multiple simultaneous growth motions — and the strategic judgment to know when to lean into each one based on what the market is telling you.


Impact You Will Have

  • Own Market Entry & Expansion: Define and execute the GTM strategy across target segments, verticals, and channels — translating Valere Evolve's platform vision into a repeatable, scalable motion that drives pipeline and accelerates time-to-revenue
  • Build the Growth Engine: Design and personally run the growth infrastructure — outbound sequences, nurture flows, content strategy, and conversion optimization — leveraging AI-native tools to operate at a velocity that outpaces traditional GTM teams
  • Drive Strategic Partnerships: Identify, develop, and close high-leverage partnerships with channel partners, systems integrators, enterprise resellers, and platform ecosystems that unlock distribution and accelerate adoption at scale — structuring agreements that embed platform value directly into partner programs as a retention and growth mechanism
  • Expand from Within: Develop and execute playbooks that convert active client relationships into platform adoption, creating organic expansion from within accounts that are already experiencing Valere's value firsthand
  • Translate Product Into Commercial Narrative: Work closely with product and delivery to develop positioning, messaging, and sales enablement that clearly articulates the value of the Learn → Build → Scale loop to enterprise buyers
  • Convert Strategy to Revenue: Build the frameworks, KPIs, and real-time dashboards that connect GTM activity to pipeline health, conversion rates, expansion revenue, and customer acquisition cost
  • Scale the User Base: Execute demand generation and account-based programs that grow the active user base across direct, partner-led, and paid acquisition channels — with measurable growth targets tied to platform adoption milestones


Key Responsibilities

  • GTM Strategy & Multi-Motion Execution — Own the full go-to-market roadmap including ICP definition, pricing frameworks, and launch execution. You will design and operate across multiple distinct growth motions simultaneously, building the systems to manage, measure, and optimize each one with clarity and speed
  • Partnership Development & Distribution — Source and structure strategic partnerships that create meaningful distribution leverage — including experience embedding platform capabilities and educational content directly into partner programs, proposals, and client engagements. Own the full partnership lifecycle from identification through activation and ongoing revenue contribution
  • Account Expansion & Organic Growth — Build and execute the internal playbooks, enablement materials, and account triggers that convert existing relationships into platform adoption and drive organic growth from within active engagements. Identify the signals that indicate expansion readiness and move on them
  • Targeted Outbound & Enterprise Penetration — Execute precision outbound campaigns targeting key individuals and internal champions inside large organizations. Build the entry-point strategy, manage the champion relationship, and develop the expansion motion that follows initial adoption to grow platform footprint organically from the inside out
  • Paid Acquisition & Influence-Driven Demand — Build and manage a paid acquisition strategy that drives platform awareness and qualified demand at scale — including the identification and activation of credible voices in the AI and enterprise transformation space to amplify reach and accelerate top-of-funnel growth
  • AI-Native Operations — Build and operate GTM workflows using AI-native tools — from prospecting automation and pipeline intelligence to content generation and deal acceleration. You use the tools. You don't delegate the tools.
  • Revenue & Pipeline Ownership — Work directly with sales and leadership to manage pipeline, forecast accuracy, and growth targets. You are accountable to the number.
  • Market Intelligence — Continuously monitor the competitive landscape, buyer behavior, and adoption trends to sharpen positioning and identify untapped growth vectors across all active acquisition channels
  • Cross-Functional Alignment — Serve as the connective layer between product, delivery, and commercial teams — ensuring GTM motion is tightly integrated with product roadmap, customer outcomes, and client-facing team capabilities


What We Look For

  • Experience: 4+ years in GTM, growth, or commercial leadership roles, with at least 2 years of demonstrated experience bringing AI products or platforms to market in a hands-on capacity
  • AI Product GTM (Required): Proven track record of taking AI-native products or platforms from early traction to scaled commercial adoption. You understand the buyer journey, the objections, the trust barriers, and what actually moves enterprise deals forward
  • AI-Native Operator (Required): You actively use and scale your work with AI tools. You have built GTM workflows, systems, and processes powered by AI automation — not as a pilot, but as standard operating procedure
  • Multi-Motion GTM Execution (Required): Demonstrated ability to design and run multiple simultaneous growth motions — partner-led distribution, account expansion, precision outbound, and paid acquisition — and the strategic maturity to resource and prioritize across them as market conditions evolve
  • Partnership Builder: Demonstrated ability to develop and close strategic partnerships that create real distribution leverage — including experience structuring agreements where platform access or educational content is embedded as a core component of the partnership value proposition
  • Account Expansion Experience: Proven ability to convert existing client or customer relationships into product adoption — building the internal plays and triggers that drive organic growth from within active accounts
  • Enterprise Outbound & Champion Development: Hands-on experience running targeted outbound to individual practitioners and decision-influencers inside large organizations, with the ability to build internal champions and develop the expansion motion that follows initial adoption
  • Paid Acquisition & Influencer Marketing: Working knowledge of paid acquisition strategy in B2B and B2B2C contexts, including performance measurement, creator or partner identification, and building programs that sustain organic reach alongside paid investment
  • Strategic Mindset with Execution Bias: You can build the roadmap and execute it in the same week. You are equally comfortable in a board-level positioning conversation and building the outbound sequence that follows it
  • Data-Driven Growth: Fluency in GTM analytics, funnel metrics, and revenue operations. You build dashboards, track what matters, and adjust based on signal — not assumption
  • Communication: Ability to translate complex platform capabilities into compelling narratives for enterprise buyers, partners, and executive stakeholders across every channel and motion
  • Builder Mentality: You don't wait for a team or a budget to grow. You find leverage, build fast, and scale what works
  • Genuine Enthusiasm for AI: Deep curiosity about the evolving AI landscape and a conviction that AI transformation is the defining enterprise challenge of this decade


How to Apply

To be considered for this role, all applicants must submit a brief Loom or video recording (5 minutes or less) shared with , including two things:

  • A personal introduction — who you are, what drives you, and why this role and this moment in AI transformation excites you
  • A concrete GTM example — walk us through a specific product or platform you've taken to market. We want the real story: the motion you chose, the obstacles you hit, how you adapted, and the measurable outcome. Slide decks and polished narratives are not what we're looking for. Show us how you think and execute.

Submissions without a video will not be reviewed. We are not evaluating production quality — we are evaluating clarity of thought, commercial instinct, and evidence of hands-on execution.

title: Full Stack Engineer (React.js/Node.js)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Full Stack Engineer with 5+ years of full stack development experience and a strong background in React.js and Node.js. You will join our clients engineering team and transform ideas and user feedback into positive experiences. You will work closely with other engineers and the user experience team iterating on designs and releasing them. Your responsibilities will include end-to-end feature development from web interfaces to backend APIs to the database. You will also communicate with the clients customers understanding their needs so you can build features with them that deliver on what you learn.


The client fosters collaboration and a close-knit working environment within its development team valuing inclusion and independent thought from its members. The client will support you as you onboard and grow within your new role, and they expect you to provide the same support to other team members. You will manage your own workload by participating in sprint planning, voicing concerns, advocating for desirable development outcomes, and proactively addressing issues. The right candidate will join a team built to produce great software!


Successful full stack engineers must have in-depth knowledge of web development concepts, a solid understanding of API and relational database design, excellent coding skills, familiarity with single page applications, and an eagerness to learn.


Our client makes trust building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The clients software platform allows companies quickly and cost effectively to adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure the efficacy of those programs against compliance standards, and share program achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simply to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable so businesses gain transparency into compliance status.


Responsibilities


  • Collaborate with User Experience and Product teams creating end-to-end, new feature designs
  • Build applications and APIs in JavaScript using React.js and Node.js
  • Develop and implement highly responsive UI components
  • Create data models using RDBMS principles implementing them in PostgreSQL
  • Troubleshoot interfaces and debug applications
  • Monitor and improve end-to-end performance
  • Communicate with and support our customers helping them find and build solutions to their problems


Required Experience


  • Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills
  • 5+ years of full stack software development experience writing single page applications that talk to API back-ends with a strong background with React.js, Node.js, JavaScript, CSS, and HTML
  • Well-developed understanding of front-end concepts and different frameworks
  • Strong back-end experience designing APIs and domain models
  • Experience working in an AWS (preferred), GCP, Azure, or other cloud environments
  • Experience designing RDBMSs to support real-world application usage
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills and experience with browser-based debugging and performance-testing software
  • A focus on customer value delivery
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Great listening skills and a willingness to understand what customers and team members need to achieve success
  • A collaborative approach, a can do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems
  • A willingness to learn from others and admit when youve made a mistake


Desired Experience


  • University degree in computer sciences/engineering or related field


Additional Information


  • Typical week is 40-45 hours, Monday Friday
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and your national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


Core Client Values


  • The clients values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.
  • Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders proving we are dependable.
  • Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team.
  • Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. Theres no excuse for being a jerk.
  • Evidence-Based Decisions : Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners.
  • Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do.
  • Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger.
  • The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people onboard from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.


About Velozient


We are a privately-held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

description:
Responsabilidades

O Grupo Smart Fit é muito mais do que a maior rede de academias da América Latina e o maior empregador de profissionais de educação física do mundo. Somos um verdadeiro ecossistema focado em bem-estar e saúde, impactando a vida de milhares de pessoas todos os dias.


Estamos em mais de 16 países, com mais de 2.000 unidades, e temos o prazer de atender mais de 5,2 milhões de alunos. Nossa equipe de 22 mil colaboradores está sempre a mil, trazendo novas ideias e inovações. Desde que abrimos nossa capital em 2021, aceleramos nossa missão de transformar vidas com soluções de fitness e saúde.


Temos várias marcas no nosso portfólio, como Bio Ritmo, Smart Fit, Race Bootcamp, Vidya Studio, Tonus Gym, Aera, Velocity, Kore TotalPass e Nation CT. Além disso, oferecemos produtos digitais como Queima Diária, Smart Fit Nutri e Smart Fit Coach. Estamos sempre procurando novas formas de integrar tecnologia e inovação para ajudar você a ter um estilo de vida mais ativo e saudável. E aí, topa o desafio junto com a gente?


O que nos move todos os dias?

Somos parte da mudança, transformando o cenário e trazendo mais qualidade para a vida de quem tá junto com a gente. Cada gotinha de suor é uma prova do nosso compromisso em inspirar e motivar todo mundo que quer uma vida mais ativa e saudável. A cada dia, começamos nossa jornada com aquecimento total, prontos para alcançar novos objetivos e viver o máximo.

  • SP - São Paulo – Residir na Capital
  • RJ - Rio de Janeiro - Residir na Capital
  • BA- Salvador - Residir na Capital
  • DF- Brasília – Residir Brasília ou Goiânia

  • Realizar tarefas rotineiras sob supervisão direta.
  • Acompanhar a execução e garantir a qualidade da manutenção preventiva e corretiva junto aos prestadores, receber e validar os relatórios para pagamento via plataforma de gestão (Trilogo).
  • Inspecionar as estruturas prediais para determinar a necessidade de reparos ou restaurações, gerar relatório de visita bimestral.

  • Experiência com Gestão de Equipe.

Nos esforçamos para manter um ambiente descontraído, onde a opinião de todos reflete nas decisões da equipe. Trabalhamos de forma colaborativa e criativa. Estamos em constante evolução e sempre abertos a novas tendências.
